raw.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are building the client's AWS enterprise cloud foundation from the ground up, and we are building it with an Agentic Software Development Life Cycle (Agentic-SDLC). We are not looking for an architect who reviews what agents produced. We are looking for one who builds the agents, defines the intents they execute, and treats the delivery system itself as part of the architecture they own.

This is the senior technical seat on the account. You will own the architecture across workstreams — the multi-account AWS landing zone (Network, Shared Services, and Workload Non-Prod and Prod), the application architecture running on top of it, and the platform architecture that comes next. You will also lead the operational team as tech lead: setting the technical direction, unblocking engineers, and shipping code yourself. This is a hands-on role. The person who owns the diagram is the person who writes the CDK.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Ownership: Own the AWS enterprise architecture end to end — multi-account governance and guardrails, Transit Gateway topology, hybrid connectivity to on-premises data centers, centralized traffic inspection, hybrid DNS, and the security posture that holds it all together. You write the ADRs, you defend them to the client, and you revisit them when they stop being true.
  • Tech Leadership with Your Hands On: Lead the operational team day to day — technical direction, design review, code review, and the architectural decisions that unblock delivery. You are also expected to build: CDK stacks, Lambda functions, agent tooling.
  • Agent Development & Orchestration: Design and extend the agents that carry our delivery — intent decomposition, design artifact generation, implementation scaffolding, validation, and gate reporting. Author the capability instructions they run on so agents produce architecture-compliant work without a human restating the standards each time. When you see the same correction made twice, you encode it once.
  • Intent-Driven Execution: Work within our Intent-Driven Framework, where intent describes client outcomes rather than task lists, ambiguity stops execution instead of getting interpreted, and every user-visible change ships behind a feature flag. High-velocity delivery in fixed-scope cycles, without scope creep or accumulated technical debt.
  • Legacy Modernization: Help systematically retire a live VB6 desktop application by moving its functionality into cloud services, while the legacy system keeps running untouched. Coexistence design — read-only replication, parity proof, staged cutover — is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought.
  • Platform Direction: Lead the platform evaluation for the external digital front: understand what the client's dealers and commercial customers actually need, assess the options, and produce a recommendation leadership and the client can act on. Then design the reuse path — external identity, tenancy, API contracts that hold once a partner integrates against them.
  • Client-Facing Architecture: Be the person in the room with the client's IT and security leadership explaining why the design is what it is, and the person who translates their constraints back into design changes.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Cloud Architecture Depth: Extensive years in software engineering with architecture, on production systems you were accountable for. Serverless application architecture — API Gateway, Lambda, CloudFront, Cognito with SAML federation, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and X-Ray.
  • Infrastructure as Code, Exclusively: AWS CDK in TypeScript, with opinions about stack boundaries and construct design. No console provisioning, no drift.
  • Software Engineering: Java and TypeScript at a level where you can review and write, not just discuss. Our stack is Java 25 with Spring Cloud Function on Lambda, React 19 with TypeScript, CDK in TypeScript. REST contract design, versioning, and backward compatibility. GitHub Actions with OIDC-based cloud authentication.
  • AI/ML Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Prompt Engineering, RAG, and Agentic Frameworks (e.g. Claude Agent SDK, Strands, LangChain, or CrewAI). Tool and MCP integration, context engineering, and a real point of view on how agent output gets verified at a scale where you cannot read all of it. AWS Bedrock and AgentCore are a plus.
  • Hybrid and Legacy Reality: Experience shipping something that had to coexist with a system nobody was allowed to touch.

Soft Skills

  • Adaptive and Agentic Mindset: Ability to pivot quickly. You should be comfortable with a "startup within a corporate" feel where priorities shift based on impact, and where the highest-value thing this week was not on the plan two weeks ago.
  • Architectural Thinking: Understanding of the "Agentic SDLC" and the ability to build systems that reduce human intervention over time. You should find it satisfying, not threatening, when something you used to do by hand becomes automatic.

Our benefits:

  • Health and dental insurance
  • Meal and food allowance
  • Childcare assistance
  • Extended paternity leave
  • Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;
  • Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);
  • Life insurance
  • Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);
  • Discount club
  • Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being
  • Pregnancy and responsible parenting course
  • Partnerships with online learning platforms
  • Language learning platform
And many more!
More details about our benefits here:

See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here.This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve. If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it.
We have a dedicated Health and Well-being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Count on us to make this journey side by side.

raw.description:
Join our dynamic Talent Acquisition (TA) team as a Talent Acquisition Operations and Analytics Specialist. This critical role manages the TA technology stack, ensures data integrity, and uses recruiting metrics to provide strategic recommendations, driving efficiency and optimizing our global talent acquisition processes. You will champion cutting-edge technology and AI to revolutionize recruiting, directly impacting the efficiency and effectiveness of our global strategy through analytical insights.

Key Responsibilities

1. Operations & Systems Management

  • System Administration: Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for core TA systems, including the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) (e.g., Greenhouse, Workday, Lever), Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) tools, and other integrated technologies.
  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate current TA processes and system configurations to identify bottlenecks and implement improvements that enhance recruiter, candidate, and hiring manager experience.
  • Data Integrity: Establish and enforce standards and governance for data input across all TA systems to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting.
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with key TA system vendors, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are met and maximizing the value of our technology investments.

2. Technology & Innovation

  • Technology Rollout & Implementation: Lead the evaluation, selection, implementation, and rigorous testing of new recruiting tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration with existing TA systems.
  • Future-Proofing TA: Stay current on emerging technology trends, specifically the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) in recruiting (e.g., automated screening, sourcing bots, interview scheduling). Develop proposals and business cases for adopting high-impact AI tools.
  • Change Management: Design and execute comprehensive change management, training, and documentation plans for the successful adoption of all new systems and feature updates across the TA team and stakeholders.

3. Analytics & Strategy

  • Metrics and Reporting: Develop, maintain, and automate key performance indicator (KPI) dashboards and operational reports across the entire recruiting funnel (e.g., time-to-hire, source-of-hire, conversion rates, candidate experience scores, diversity metrics).
  • Data Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analyses on recruiting performance data to identify trends, root causes of inefficiencies, and areas for strategic intervention.
  • Strategic Recommendations: Translate complex data findings into clear, concise, and actionable strategic recommendations for TA leadership and recruiting teams to improve quality of hire, speed, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Forecasting: Assist in workforce planning and forecasting by providing data-driven insights on anticipated hiring needs and capacity.

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in a Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, or People Analytics role, with a focus on supporting a recruiting function.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proven expertise as an administrator or super-user of a major Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Reporting Tools: Proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, advanced Excel/Google Sheets).
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex data insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience leading the implementation or significant rollout of an ATS or other core TA technology.
  • Demonstrated interest or experience with AI/ML applications in the Human Resources or Talent Acquisition space.
  • Project management certification or proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.

Twist Bioscience Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Twist Bioscience Corporation provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic characteristics, or any other category protected by law.

Job ID: IOHPJC1

Ready to step into a sales role where you never have to cold call again?

We are a rapidly growing remote staffing company based in Los Angeles, California, and we are looking for a driven, experienced Sales Representative to own the full sales cycle and close deals.

This isn't an appointment-setting role. This is 100% inbound sales where you will be running real sales conversations from day one. We keep the pipeline full so you can focus entirely on what you do best: selling.

The Compensation

  • Base Salary: $2,500/mo USD + commissions

  • Total Compensation: $6,000 - $10,000/mo+ USD

Why This Role is Different

  • Zero Cold Calling: Prospects book directly onto your calendar from our proven Meta ad campaigns.

  • High-Quality Leads: We boast a 75% show rate and a 90% qualified rate.

  • Real Upside: Have fun, earn exceptional income, and work 1-on-1 with the company owner.

  • Supportive Environment: Receive daily coaching, ongoing training, and work inside a highly successful, proven system.

What You’ll Do

  • Run scheduled sales calls over Google Meet using our pitch deck.

  • Manage your full pipeline in GoHighLevel—from booked meeting to closed deal.

  • Follow up consistently with prospects until they convert or close out.

  • Own your numbers and your process end-to-end.

  • Participate in daily team trainings and coaching sessions to constantly level up.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 2+ years of proven closing experience: This is a non-negotiable requirement. We need closers, not appointment setters.

  • Executive Presence: Confident, clear communicator who can hold a room and drive a call to a decision.

  • Tech-Savvy: Experience managing a pipeline with a CRM (GoHighLevel is a strong plus).

  • Driven & Organized: Self-managed and disciplined with your follow-up and pipeline hygiene.

  • Growth Mindset: Coachable, team-oriented, hungry, and committed to constant improvement.

Is This For You?

We have an amazing team dedicated to succeeding, growing, and enjoying every minute of it. However, we are looking for serious professionals only. We have a fast-paced, growth-oriented culture that is laser-focused on success.

If you don't want to show up every day ready to get after it, then this job is not for you. Don't waste either of our time. But if you are ready to crush your goals and elevate your career, we want to talk to you.

raw.description:
HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. We’re headquartered in Palma, Mallorca and employ around 3,500 people worldwide.


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Commercial Strategy Manager leads the design and implementation of commercial prioritisation frameworks for HBX Eco-system units as well as the discovery, planning, quantification and execution of specific strategic opportunities.

The role works closely together with commercial and business unit leaders (e.g. Sales, Sourcing, Fintech, Mobility & Experiences, HotelTech-Roiback) and Sales & Sourcing Centers of Excellence to (i) align & implement key strategic priorities and (ii) drive key strategic projects.

The role oversees that all commercial roadmaps adhere to consistent (high-quality) standards across the company, with the right level of granularity and fulfilling all the necessary requirements based on advanced quality frameworks

(e.g. valid go-to-market strategy, solid commercial enablement plan, etc).

The role also leads the design and execution of specific strategic projects leveraging TO Control and Project Excellence project management capabilities. The role is responsible for leading financial, risk and opportunity quantification analysis - elevating key outcomes to the Functional Lead.

The role coordinates the performance and status reporting of all specific commercial strategy workstreams and strategic projects to be presented in the Transformation Office and other relevant leadership forums including the Executive Committee and Advisory Committee.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of commercial prioritization frameworks across Eco-system products, markets and segments by working together with commercial and business unit leaders

  • Designs, implements and ensures adherence of Eco-system commercial strategies to quality frameworks by applying commercial planning methodologies and through stretched collaboration with business unit leaders

  • Manages the consolidated roadmap for business unit commercial plans to ensure (i) alignment with strategic priorities and (ii) consistency & adherence to quality standards

  • Leads the strategic discovery (assessment of the opportunity), planning, quantification (key topline drivers & cost/capex requirements) and execution of specific strategic opportunities by collaborating with functional leads and leveraging TO Control and Project Center of Excellence for optimal project planning and governance

  • Develops the strategy, performance and status reporting of specific commercial strategy workstreams and strategic projects to be presented in leadership group meetings, Transformation Office, Executive Committee and Advisory Committee

Skills:

  • Proficiency in data analysis and interpretation (to drive strategic decisions)

  • Strong presentation skills to synthesize complex topics into actionable insights (for senior stakeholders)

  • Solid analytical, problem solving, creative thinking and communication skills (verbal and written)

  • Entrepreneurial spirit to bring innovative ideas about commercial strategy innovation

  • Project management and planning skills

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage with stakeholders at all levels (ability to synthesize complex topics into actionable insights for senior stakeholders)

  • Good judgement with the ability to make timely and sound decisions

  • Strong financial acumen (strong understanding of financial principles and budgeting processes)

  • Coaching skills and ability to delegate, train, lead and motivate team members

Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience managing commercial strategy and strategic projects at a global organization or in a Strategy Consulting firm

  • Proven experience in commercial strategy frameworks and methodologies

  • Experience managing and developing people in a multicultural and global organization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering or related

  • Master’s degree or MBA highly preferable

You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

As well as an attractive benefits package you will be able to work:

  • Within an innovative, engaging and multicultural environment.

  • Have the opportunity to build strong and lasting business relationships and friendships from around the world.

  • Have the opportunity in developing your career locally or within one of our beautiful working locations across the globe.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4-6 CPG accounts, primarily beauty, personal care, wellness, or food and beverage brands. This role centers on a comprehensive diagnosis of core business constraints impacting client growth, leveraging a deep understanding of the competitive landscape to identify and formulate strategic solutions. This includes pinpointing challenges across all points of sale - DTC/ecommerce acquisition, retail execution, Amazon market share erosion, or upstream strategic barriers like brand positioning - and developing a unified, data-backed strategy to overcome them.

CPG accounts tend to have opinions about their channels that predate the data. Part of this job is having the product, competitive, and retail fluency to challenge those assumptions with credibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with particular attention to how the client's retail and DTC performance interact
  • Own the senior client relationship
  • QBRs should drive decisions, not report history
  • Consult on channel mix across DTC, Amazon, and retail — understand how they cannibalize or reinforce each other and make a recommendation
  • Coordinate paid, SEO, content, influencer, and creative teams around a single account strategy
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR in your portfolio
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our proprietary diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Manage and develop 1–2 direct reports — run regular 1:1s, build development plans, and own their performance reviews
  • Coach analysts and specialists; give specific, timely feedback

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in CPG marketing, ideally with both DTC and retail brand experience
  • Understands how Amazon fits into a CPG growth strategy — share of search, ASIN architecture, buy box, sponsored vs. organic balance
  • Familiar with the retailer relationship layer: how Target, Ulta, Sephora, Whole Foods, or similar partners shape media investment decisions
  • Has an opinion on CPG measurement — MMM, incrementality testing, in-store vs. digital attribution
  • Fluent in upper-funnel channel strategy — content, SEO, YouTube, programmatic
  • Comfortable with creative-heavy accounts where briefs, asset velocity, and influencer strategy are as important as media optimization
  • Track record of retaining and growing accounts
  • Has managed senior clients who have strong brand opinions and needs to be met with confidence

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Prepaid Medicine Plan

About the Role

At Pavago, we are hiring for one of our clients seeking a detail-oriented Transaction Coordinator to manage the administrative and compliance side of real estate transactions in California.

You will support agents from the time a purchase agreement is signed through the close of escrow. Your role will be to keep transaction files organized, track important deadlines, make sure required documents are completed, and coordinate with agents, escrow/title officers, lenders, clients, and other parties involved in the transaction.

This is an operations-focused role that requires strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple transactions at the same time.

Responsibilities

Transaction & File Management

  • Open and manage transaction files in the transaction management platform from executed purchase agreement through close of escrow.
  • Review contracts, addenda, and disclosures to make sure files are complete and properly documented.
  • Maintain organized and accurate transaction files according to brokerage recordkeeping and compliance requirements.
  • Prepare and organize documents for review, approval, and signature.

Deadlines & Compliance

  • Track important transaction deadlines, including contingency periods, inspection windows, loan and appraisal contingencies, and close-of-escrow dates.
  • Proactively monitor deadlines and alert agents when action is required.
  • Collect and confirm required California disclosure forms and transaction documents.
  • Help ensure transaction files meet California and brokerage compliance requirements.
  • Identify missing or incomplete documents before they create delays or compliance issues.

Communication & Coordination

  • Act as a point of contact between agents, escrow/title officers, lenders, clients, and other transaction parties.
  • Keep all relevant parties informed about transaction progress and outstanding requirements.
  • Follow up on pending documents, signatures, approvals, and other transaction items.
  • Help keep transactions moving smoothly from contract to closing.

Documents & Transaction Support

  • Prepare and route documents for electronic signatures using platforms such as DocuSign or similar tools.
  • Coordinate additional transaction items such as home warranty orders, repair documentation, and vendor scheduling.
  • Support agents with administrative tasks related to active transactions.
  • Manage multiple files and transactions while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple deadlines at the same time.
  • You pay close attention to details and can quickly identify missing or incorrect information.
  • You are proactive and follow up on tasks without needing constant supervision.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally with agents, clients, and external partners.
  • You are comfortable working with contracts, disclosures, transaction documents, and real estate systems.
  • You can stay organized and calm while managing multiple transactions at different stages.
  • You take ownership of your work and understand the importance of accuracy in real estate transactions.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Haves

  • 1–3+ years of experience as a Transaction Coordinator, Escrow Assistant, or in a similar real estate transaction support role.
  • Working knowledge of California residential real estate transactions, contracts, timelines, and disclosure requirements.
  • Strong understanding of transaction coordination from executed contract through close of escrow.
  • Experience managing multiple transactions, files, or deadlines at the same time.
  • Experience using transaction management and electronic signature platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to proactively track deadlines and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Ability to work independently and manage tasks without constant supervision.
  • California Real Estate License is not required for this role.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience supporting multiple real estate agents or a full brokerage team.
  • Experience with DocuSign Rooms, Dotloop, or similar transaction management platforms.
  • Experience working with California disclosure forms such as TDS, NHD, SPQ, and AVID.
  • Previous experience coordinating with escrow/title companies, lenders, and other transaction partners.
  • Bilingual Spanish/English communication skills.
  • Experience working in a real estate brokerage or transaction coordination environment.

Interview Process

  • Initial screening with Pavago.
  • Client interview.
  • Final selection and onboarding.

About the Team

At DoorDash, including international brands Deliveroo and Wolt, we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and Dashers. Global Cyber Defense is a highly talented and globally distributed team that covers response, intelligence, insider risk, threat hunting, automation, and detection engineering.

We exist to keep our brands safe for the Dashers, merchants, and consumers who depend on us. Our mission is to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats with speed and precision, while continuously hardening our defenses through automation, AI, and cross-regional collaboration.

About the Role

The senior detection engineer is part of the larger detection engineering team that creates, tunes, maintains, and improves the detection lifecycle. This hands-on role is at the forefront of agentic detection engineering of a rapidly maturing security function. You’ll work closely with our data pipelines team, incident response, insider risk, and threat intelligence teams to make the most effective detection content to detect threats as quickly as possible.

Detection at DoorDash spans more than the corporate estate. You’ll build coverage across cloud infrastructure, corporate endpoints and identity, and the marketplace itself - where consumer, merchant, and Dasher platforms create abuse and insider-risk patterns you won’t find in a typical enterprise SOC. We’re actively consolidating detection onto a modern data platform, so you’ll have real influence over what the pipeline looks like.

This role reports to the Senior Manager, Cyber Defense located in the United States and participation in an on-call rotation is required for this role.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Conduct hands-on detection engineering for custom alerting, to include implementing risk-based analytics to reduce alert volumes and promote high-fidelity alert content
  • Integrate external signals such as threat intelligence into alerting pipelines tailored to specific use cases
  • Develop and maintain agentic tooling to increase detection efficacy and efficiency
  • Leverage security tooling, logs, and custom telemetry to build detections at scale
  • Work with structured and unstructured telemetry to produce meaningful security signals
  • Maintain detection repositories, use case libraries, and conduct routine content optimization
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams, internally and externally, on threats targeting DoorDash
  • Participate in and lead projects that improve the security posture of all DoorDash brands
  • Create and maintain standards and documentation to improve service consistency
  • Mentor and uplevel other engineers within the Cyber Defense organization
  • Participate in and support our on-call rotation

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 7+ years of experience in secure coding, alert development, and detection engineering.
  • Direct experience building, maintaining, and operating a detection-as-code pipeline
  • A proven track record building automation that measurably improved detection accuracy, velocity, or quality
  • Demonstrated experience building agents to effectively and efficiently solve detection problems
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud based and distributed systems
  • Experience working with global and cross-functional partners, especially incident response, insider risk, and threat hunting teams
  • Mastery of SIEM querying (sql, spl, kql) and programming languages (python, go, etc)
  • Experience translating MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND, and other industry frameworks into meaningful rationalizations of detection coverage
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience with Snowflake, Cortex, Google SecOps is preferred

Compensation

Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

raw.description:
Proper AI is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators.

By combining automation, technology, and a global team of accounting experts, we deliver faster, more accurate financial operations at scale.

We’re a team of builders, problem-solvers, and operators from around the world, working together to modernize one of the most critical functions in real estate.

Learn more at

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong backend and systems fundamentals to help own the core of our platform: the services, data models, and automations behind workflow and productivity tooling for B2B accounting operations.

This is a depth role, not a breadth role. The work is logic-heavy — multi-service data flows, third-party platform integrations, and document-processing pipelines where correctness matters more than surface area. The engineer will be a technical counterpart to the Tech Lead on architecture, and will take ownership of our AI-backed document processing service.

The ideal candidate is language-agnostic in outlook but deep in practice: comfortable moving between Go, Python, and TypeScript, and able to build a real working model of an unfamiliar system before changing it.

Key Responsibilities

    Core Functional Responsibilities

    • Design, build, and maintain backend services across a microservices estate (Go, NestJS/TypeScript, Python).

    • Own the AI-backed document processing and classification service (Python/FastAPI): extraction quality, accuracy measurement, and the pipeline around it.

    • Design and maintain integrations with third-party platforms, including authentication, sync cadence, retries, and recovery.

    • Model data deliberately — schemas, migrations, and invariants that hold as the product changes.

    • Debug across service boundaries: correlate behaviour across multiple systems and databases to find the actual cause.

    • Build observability and provenance into automated flows: actions should be traceable, auditable, and reconstructable after the fact.

    • Design for safe automation: idempotency, pre/postconditions, dry-runs, and guardrails on anything that writes to a customer's system of record.

    • Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and leave the systems better instrumented than found.

      • Performance and Metrics Tracking

      • Define and track correctness and reliability measures for owned systems (task success, error and fallback rates, accuracy of automated inference).

      • Build evaluation coverage for AI-backed output: scenario tests, invariant checks, and regression detection when a model or prompt changes.

      • Monitor and improve latency, retries, and failure recovery in automated pipelines.

        • Training and Development

        • Mentor mid-level engineers on system design, debugging methodology, and testing discipline.

        • Lead design discussions and code reviews.

        • Document architecture decisions, failure modes, and debugging runbooks.

Required Hard Skills

  • Backend engineering depth — production services in Go and/or Python; TypeScript/Node useful. Multi-language comfort matters more than any single stack.
  • Data modelling and relational databases — PostgreSQL, schema design, migrations, query performance, and reasoning about data integrity.
  • Distributed and cross-service debugging — tracing behaviour across services, queues, and databases to isolate a root cause.
  • Third-party integration engineering — external APIs with imperfect contracts: auth expiry, partial failures, retries, idempotency.
  • Reliability practice — observability, structured logging, tracing, failure-mode analysis, and recovery design.
  • Testing and evaluation — unit and scenario tests, invariant checks, and measuring correctness of non-deterministic (AI-backed) output.
  • Cloud and infrastructure — GCP preferred (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub); Docker and CI/CD.
  • Working with LLM-backed services — using them as components, understanding their failure modes, and validating their output. Prior agent-framework experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Required Soft Skills

  • Calibrates depth to stakes. Ships routine, low-risk work quickly; deliberately slows down on core systems, data models, and anything touching money or client data — and can tell the difference without being told.

  • Verifies before concluding. Checks the premise of a bug report rather than building on it; can distinguish a real defect from correct behaviour measured the wrong way. Reads the system before changing it. Builds a working model of how something actually behaves, then changes it.

  • Owns outcomes, not tickets. Goes past the literal ticket text when the ticket is wrong, incomplete, or describes the wrong problem.

  • Strong communicator of design decisions, trade-offs, and risk, to technical and non technical audiences.

  • Pragmatic and collaborative — high standards without perfectionism, and works well with Product and Operations.

Nice-to-Have Skills / Experiences

  • Experience in both high-growth startups and larger engineering organisations. Accounting, fintech, or other domain where correctness is non-negotiable. Document processing, OCR, or information-extraction pipelines.

  • Vector databases / retrieval (e.g. Qdrant) and prompt or model evaluation. Frontend familiarity (Vue or React) — useful for full-feature ownership, not a core requirement.

  • B2B SaaS background.

Type of Degree

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. Strong CS fundamentals matter; the credential does not.

Years of Experience in Field

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering, with a majority in backend or systems work. Demonstrated ownership of a non-trivial production system (not just feature delivery within someone else's design).

  • Experience at an organisation with mature engineering standards is valuable.

Proper is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse environment to work by offering the same opportunities to all applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, disability, national origins, marital status, or other characteristics. We base our talent search exclusively on competencies, abilities and potential.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

What the Role is:

As the Measurement Product Marketing Lead, you will define, position, and scale Pinterest's advertiser measurement strategy spanning attribution, signal quality, data partnerships, and measurement infrastructure to help advertisers understand and grow performance in an increasingly complex landscape.

This role is responsible for shaping how Pinterest brings measurement solutions to market, including attribution coverage, first-party data capabilities, incrementality, and emerging methodologies that give advertisers confidence in Pinterest's ability to deliver and prove results. You will play a critical role in sustaining and growing advertiser outcomes amid evolving platform changes, signal loss, shifting measurement expectations, and a rapidly changing industry landscape.

You will serve as the connective tissue across Product, Data Science, Engineering, Sales, Legal, and senior leadership ensuring that new solutions are commercially clear, technically sound, and grounded in advertiser impact. This includes driving inbound market and competitive research, developing compelling narratives for advertisers, partnering with EPD to assess business implications before rollout, and ensuring attribution coverage is treated as a top-level strategic priority.

What You'll Do:

  • Define the strategic narrative and positioning for Pinterest's measurement capabilities, helping advertisers and the industry understand Pinterest's approach to attribution, signal quality, and performance visibility.
  • Lead go-to-market strategy and commercial readiness for new measurement products and capabilities including messaging, launch plans, advertiser-facing materials, sales enablement, onboarding guides, objection handling, and escalation frameworks.
  • Make attribution coverage a top-level product and business priority by partnering with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and senior leadership to assess how signal availability, data sources, and product changes affect advertiser reporting, optimization, and performance visibility.
  • Drive roadmap input, rollout planning, and business impact assessment for measurement changes ensuring advertiser impact, product scalability, and revenue implications are understood and incorporated before launch.
  • Shape Pinterest's market and industry thought leadership on advertiser measurement through competitive research, advertiser insights, executive narratives, and clear enablement for Sales, Client Solutions, and external audiences.

What we’re looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Product Management, Strategy, or related roles, ideally within social, tech, ads, measurement, data, privacy, or adtech platforms.

This opportunity is for experienced People and HR professionals who enjoy variety, take ownership and want to join a growing consultancy supporting ambitious organisations across the US and internationally.

About Rosie's People

Rosie's People is an award-winning HR/People Operations and organisational consultancy supporting founders, leadership teams and growing organisations across the UK and internationally.

We provide strategic People advisory, organisational consulting, operational HR support, leadership and management development, talent solutions and executive recruitment.

As our international client portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our network of experienced independent HR and People consultants across the United States.

We are particularly interested in consultants who can support clients in and around New York City, Washington DC and San Francisco, although applications from experienced consultants elsewhere in the US are also welcome.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your resume/CV together with a cover letter explaining why you believe you would be a strong addition to the Rosie's People consultant network.

Within your cover letter, please answer the following six mandatory questions.

Applications that do not answer all six questions will not be considered.

1. Location, Right to Work & Travel
Where are you currently based? Please confirm that you have the legal right to work as an independent consultant in the United States without sponsorship, and state which US cities/states you could reasonably support in person.

2. HR Experience & Employment Practice
How many years of substantive HR/People experience do you have? Please list the US states in which you have practical HR/employment experience and briefly describe one complex employee relations or People matter that you personally managed and the outcome.

3. Qualifications & Specialist Experience
Please list your relevant HR/People qualifications or certifications, including SHRM, HRCI or equivalent where applicable. Please also identify any specialist experience you have, for example organisational design, M&A/integration, restructuring, performance management, HR compliance, international HR, culture or leadership development.

4. Consultancy & International Working
Please briefly describe your experience working independently with senior stakeholders and/or clients. Include any experience supporting international, geographically distributed or cross-cultural teams and how you manage communication, ownership and escalation when operating as part of a wider consultancy or client team.

5. Availability & Consultancy Rates
What capacity could you typically make available for project work, and how quickly could you mobilise if selected for an assignment? Please provide your expected hourly and full-day consultancy rates in USD, excluding applicable taxes.

Applications stating market rate, negotiable, dependent on scope, or asking what the budget is or similar responses will not be considered.

6. AI, HR Systems & Technology
Please list the AI tools, HR systems and productivity software you have used professionally. Next to each, rate your competency as:

Beginner | Intermediate | Expert | Never Used

About the Opportunity

Successful applicants may be added to Rosie's People's approved consultant network and considered for client assignments as requirements arise.

Assignments may include:

  • Day-to-day and strategic HR support
  • Employee relations and manager advisory
  • Performance management
  • HR policies, processes and compliance
  • Organisational design and change
  • M&A and post-acquisition integration
  • Workforce planning and restructuring
  • Recruitment, onboarding and offboarding
  • HR audits and People-practice reviews
  • Supporting international and distributed workforces
  • Manager capability and organisational-development projects

Whilst you will manage your day-to-day workload independently, assignments will form part of Rosie's People's managed consultancy service and operate within agreed client scope, reporting, escalation and quality standards.

Our Ideal Consultant

We're looking for people who:

  • Have at least five years' substantive HR/People experience
  • Have strong practical knowledge of employment requirements applicable to the jurisdictions they support
  • Can confidently manage employee relations matters
  • Communicate credibly with managers, executives and founders
  • Are commercially minded, pragmatic and solutions-focused
  • Can enter a client environment and add value quickly
  • Understand the difference between independence and disappearing
  • Know when to take ownership, collaborate and escalate
  • Are comfortable with modern HR systems, AI tools and collaborative technology
  • Can represent the Rosie's People brand professionally

Relevant SHRM, HRCI or equivalent professional qualifications are desirable, although substantial practical experience will also be considered.

Important

Joining the Rosie's People consultant network does not constitute an offer or guarantee of work.

Client assignments are offered according to business requirements, expertise, location, availability, cultural/client fit and agreed commercial terms.

Where you are considered for a specific assignment, the scope, expected hours or days, duration, rate, travel requirements and other relevant terms will be agreed before any work commences.

Rosie's People is a remote-first, inclusive and equal opportunities consultancy. If you require reasonable adjustments during our selection process, please include a Reasonable Adjustment Request section within your cover letter.

To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Are you passionate about building and scaling enterprise finance systems that power global business operations? Join Pinterest’s IT Enterprise Systems team, where you’ll play a key role in evolving our Oracle EBS and Finance technology landscape. This is an opportunity to drive meaningful impact by partnering with Finance, Accounting, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and business-critical ERP solutions that support Pinterest’s continued growth.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Oracle EBS Financials across accounting-centric processes, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, subledger accounting and related integrations.
  • Lead solution design, configuration, support, and continuous improvement across accounting processes, with emphasis on close acceleration, data accuracy, control strength, and audit readiness.
  • Apply AI thoughtfully to improve systems analysis, documentation, and operational efficiency, while exercising sound judgment, governance, and risk awareness in finance-critical environments.
  • Support end-to-end integrations between Oracle EBS and external enterprise applications, including SaaS and cloud-based systems that impact accounting operations, reconciliations, and financial reporting.
  • Work closely with Accounting stakeholders to understand operational requirements and translate them into scalable solutions across Oracle EBS and connected cloud platforms.
  • Help define and execute the Oracle ERP roadmap in partnership with product owners, systems managers, and business leaders, aligning technology investments with strategic business priorities.
  • Assess and enhance record-to-report and related finance processes by identifying ways to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, and improve operational effectiveness.
  • Ensure strong SDLC, change management, and SOX-compliant processes across the ERP ecosystem, with a focus on auditability, stability, and risk mitigation.
  • Collaborate with Managed Service Partners and internal teams to promote operational excellence, support best practices, and continuously improve service delivery.
  • Partner across Finance and IT to support broader ERP modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Business Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience implementing, supporting, and enhancing Oracle EBS in large, complex enterprise environments.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle EBS Financials, including strong hands-on knowledge of GL, AP, CM, FA, SLA, and accounting control frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials is a plus.
  • Ability to use AI responsibly in enterprise environments, with attention to security, privacy, governance, and the validation of AI-assisted outputs before use in production or business-critical workflows.
  • Strong functional understanding of end-to-end Finance processes, accounting operations, and ERP controls in a public-company or highly regulated environment.
  • Experience leading Oracle EBS configuration, enhancements, issue resolution, release coordination, and cross-functional systems initiatives.
  • Solid understanding of Oracle EBS integrations, enterprise application architecture, and cloud integration frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of SOX controls, audit readiness, compliance requirements, and change management practices within ERP and financial systems.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with proven success working across Finance, IT, vendors, and global cross-functional teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, systems thinking, and a track record of delivering reliable, scalable, and business-focused enterprise solutions.Join us to be part of a forward-thinking team at Pinterest, where your expertise will help lay the foundation for future financial innovation!

ÜBER DAS SYNTAX INSTITUT

Das Syntax Institut ist ein schnell wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen aus Berlin, das von erfolgreichen Unternehmern gegründet wurde. Unsere Mission ist es, Menschen praxisnah für gefragte Berufe in der Tech-Branche zu qualifizieren und sie erfolgreich in den Arbeitsmarkt zu integrieren. Unser Angebot umfasst praxisnahe Weiterbildungen in den Bereichen Softwareentwicklung, IT-Administration, Cloud & IT-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Projektmanagement. Darüber hinaus bieten wir deutschlandweit an mehreren Standorten Umschulungen im Bereich Fachinformatik an. Dabei vermitteln wir aktuelle Technologien, moderne Arbeitsmethoden und die Fähigkeiten, die Unternehmen heute tatsächlich benötigen.

  • Beratung: Du informierst Interessierte umfassend über unser Kursangebot, analysierst ihre individuelle Situation und Lernziele und bereitest sie zielgerichtet auf den Kursstart vor

DAS SOLLTEST DU MITBRINGEN

  • Spaß an Dynamik und ambitionierten Zielen: Du bist motiviert klare und ambitionierte Ziele zu erreichen und dabei erstklassige Ergebnisse zu erzielen
  • Selbständigkeit und Proaktivität: Du arbeitest gerne selbständig und eigenverantwortlich und behältst stets den Überblick, insbesondere beim gleichzeitigen Bearbeiten von eingegangenen Bewerbungen

raw.description:
Partner One is a long-term investment group specializing in the acquisition and growth of successful software companies. With over 30 years in business, we own and operate some of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies globally. More than 2,000 of the world’s largest corporations and governments rely on our software for their most critical operations and to safeguard their most valuable data.

We are seeking an M&A Associate to join our team in a full-time, remote, permanent capacity.

The M&A Associate will be part of the Mergers & Acquisitions team and will play a key role in supporting the research, evaluation, due diligence, and execution of acquisitions, with exposure to a high volume of live opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and source software businesses that meet our acquisition criteria and key performance metrics
  • Develop and execute targeted prospecting campaigns via email and outbound calls, while continuously testing new business development strategies, with exposure to a high volume of deal opportunities
  • Build and nurture relationships with prospective acquisition targets and sell-side M&A investment banking firms
  • Lead preliminary evaluations of potential acquisitions, including initial business and financial due diligence, as well as opportunity and risk assessments
  • Own and manage a robust deal pipeline, ensuring it is consistently updated as new targets and information emerge, while working alongside a team of entrepreneurial, high-performing, and motivated individuals
  • Conduct industry and market research to identify trends and uncover new acquisition opportunities
  • Review and analyze investment materials, synthesizing large volumes of data into clear, concise, and actionable insights and presentations
  • Independently drive acquisition opportunities forward by understanding deal scope and maintaining momentum throughout the process, with exposure to the full deal lifecycle from sourcing to execution
  • Prioritize and delegate tasks effectively based on deal timelines and strategic importance
  • Provide ad hoc analytical and operational support to the broader team as needed
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support data requests, due diligence, internal alignment, and successful deal execution

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of experience in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Corporate Development is required
  • Prior experience with software M&A transactions is a must
  • Strong academic performance from a top-tier institution
  • Undergraduate degree in business or a related field is preferred
  • Professional maturity and confidence in interacting with C-level executives
  • Highly proactive, self-directed, and driven, with strong sales and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated leadership potential
  • Solid foundation in accounting principles and financial modeling
  • Understanding of software business models and the M&A transaction lifecycle
  • Strong analytical ability, pattern recognition skills, and advanced Excel proficiency

Compensation Base Range: $80,000 – $90,00 CAD annually

Commission: Additional commission structure available

This recruitment process may use automated or artificial intelligence to screen or assess applicants.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy.

raw.title: Senior Lead, Enterprise Partnerships & Strategy
raw.excerpt: Why Thunderbird? Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally.
raw.description:
Why Thunderbird?

Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At MZLA, the team behind Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.

We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.

We are a small but growing company of 60+ people distributed across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, and new product experiences that help people and organizations work more effectively without giving up control to big tech ecosystems.

Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s apps freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.

A note about MZLA and Mozilla: MZLA Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird and part of the Mozilla family. MZLA is separate from Mozilla Corporation and has its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.

To learn more, visit and

The opportunity

MZLA is entering a new phase of growth as we bring Thunderbird, Thunderbolt, and other current and future products and services into the enterprise market. Our enterprise approach will be partner-led, with external partners leading sales, implementation, and ongoing customer relationships while MZLA provides the products, technical expertise, and subject-matter knowledge needed for success.

Our move into the enterprise market is being shaped in part by growing interest in digital sovereignty, particularly in Europe, where enterprises and public-sector organizations are placing greater emphasis on control over data and infrastructure, deployment flexibility, privacy, security, interoperability, and reduced vendor dependence.

We are looking for a Senior Lead, Enterprise Partnerships & Strategy to add dedicated partnership and commercial expertise to work already underway. You will partner closely with the CEO, senior leadership, and cross-functional teams to shape MZLA’s enterprise strategy, evaluate opportunities, develop partnership and commercial models, shape pricing and packaging, and advance a cohesive enterprise offering across our products and services.

This is a hands-on role in a lean environment. Success will require someone who can operate credibly with senior leaders and external partners while remaining closely involved in the analysis, preparation, coordination, negotiation, and follow-through needed to move opportunities forward and build a more repeatable enterprise approach.

This role requires regular working-hour overlap with colleagues in North American time zones, as well as flexibility to meet with partners and stakeholders across Europe. This role will also include periodic travel, including international, to meet with partners, prospective customers and represent MZLA at relevant industry events.

What you’ll do

  • Help define and execute an enterprise strategy across MZLA’s products and services.
  • Translate digital sovereignty priorities into clear enterprise and partnership requirements.
  • Identify, evaluate, and advance enterprise opportunities and strategic partnerships, particularly in Europe and other sovereignty-focused markets.
  • Work with stakeholders to clarify roles across MZLA, external partners, and other Mozilla entities.
  • Develop pricing, packaging, licensing, reseller, revenue-sharing, support, implementation, and other commercial models.
  • Lead or support partner negotiations and senior-level commercial discussions.
  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to understand capabilities, deployment options, integrations, security and privacy considerations, support requirements, and roadmap dependencies.
  • Translate technical capabilities into clear enterprise propositions and partner plans.
  • Build practical processes and decision frameworks that support repeatable execution and help ensure external commitments remain realistic and supportable.

What you bring

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience in product or strategic partnerships, enterprise strategy, commercial strategy, or technical business development.
  • Experience building a new partnership, enterprise, platform, or commercial capability in a partner-led environment.
  • Experience working with European enterprises, public-sector organizations, regulated institutions, technology partners, or similarly complex stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of digital sovereignty and the commercial, technical, regulatory, legal, and procurement considerations shaping technology decisions in Europe.
  • Experience working through resellers, systems integrators, implementation partners, or similar partner-led enterprise models.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and negotiating pricing, packaging, licensing, reseller, revenue-sharing, implementation, support, or similar commercial models, with strong judgment around enterprise buying processes, deal economics, negotiation strategy, and complex procurement.
  • Experience with technically complex software products, platforms, infrastructure, AI-enabled systems, communications technology, security, or privacy technology, with the technical and product fluency to work credibly with engineering, product, partner, and enterprise stakeholders.
  • Strong executive communication, relationship-management, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguous opportunities and move comfortably between strategy and detailed execution.
  • A collaborative, low-ego working style and the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Strong alignment with Mozilla’s mission and values, including openness, privacy, user agency, trust, and long-term sustainability.
  • Ability and willingness to travel periodically, including internationally.

Bonus points for

  • Experience with on-premises, self-hosted, private-cloud, in-region, or other customer-controlled deployment models.
  • Experience with open-source software, open standards, or open technology ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled software, enterprise search, knowledge systems, communications platforms, productivity tools, or privacy-oriented technology.
  • Experience building partnerships or enterprise initiatives in an early-stage company, new business unit, or newly established function.
  • Experience coordinating partnerships across affiliated organizations or a portfolio of related products.

About you

You are a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable working in the details. You know that successful partnerships depend on more than strong relationships: they require sound product judgment, clear commercial models, technical credibility, and disciplined execution.

You understand that enterprise technology decisions are shaped not only by features and price, but also by control, jurisdiction, trust, interoperability, and long-term technology dependence. You can translate those considerations into practical enterprise and partnership strategies without overstating what a product or organization can deliver.

You are comfortable representing an organization in senior external conversations while remaining hands-on with pricing, preparation, technical dependencies, coordination, and follow-through. You are motivated by building a durable enterprise capability in a lean environment rather than inheriting a mature program or immediately building a large team.

Work environment

This is a full-time, fully remote position. You’ll work with colleagues, partners, and customers across multiple countries and time zones, so strong communication and documentation skills are essential.

Compensation & benefits

We benchmark our base salaries to local markets and target the 60th percentile of the peer market. The salary ranges for this role are:

  • Canada: $140,000-$180,000 CAD

This is a salaried, non-commissioned role and is eligible for MZLA’s annual discretionary bonus program.

The salary range shown reflects the intended level and scope of the position. We may consider candidates with strong relevant skills but less experience, in which case title, level, and compensation may be adjusted accordingly.

In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your whole self.

Work & career

  • Fully remote work & schedule flexibility
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Annual bonus program
  • Monthly remote work stipend
  • Annual professional development stipend
  • Access toCoursera learning platform
  • Industry conferences
  • Company all-hands and team gatherings

Rest & play

  • 24 days PTO per year (prorated)
  • Your birthday
  • Year-end company shutdown
  • 9 wellbeing days
  • Public holidays
  • Other paid leave
  • Quarterly wellbeing stipend for personal / family activities

Health & family

  • RRSP contributions
  • Health, dental, & vision insurance
  • Disability insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid sick days

Work eligibility

Applicants must reside in and have permanent work authorization for the country location(s) specified in the posting. We are unable to consider applicants outside of these markets at this time. And, we do not provide visa sponsorship.

How to apply

Please apply directly through our career page. We carefully review every cover letter and screening question, so take the time to answer each fully.We value authentic, thoughtful responses that reflect your own experience and perspective. It is fine to use AI tools to polish your writing, but your answers should be your own. Candidates who submit generic or unoriginal AI-generated responses may be disqualified from further consideration.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

MZLA believes in the value of diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge, and knows diversity, equity and inclusion are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. MZLA will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us to request accommodation.

raw.excerpt: About Sunrise GroupSunrise Group is building the future of sleep health by combining breakthrough technology with expert care.
raw.description:
About Sunrise Group

Sunrise Group is building the future of sleep health by combining breakthrough technology with expert care. We started in 2015 with a straightforward idea: sleep diagnosis should happen in the comfort of your own home, not in a hospital. To make that possible, we created a first-of-its-kind chin sensor, carefully validated through clinical research, reviewed by leading sleep experts, and cleared by the FDA.

Since then, Sunrise Group has grown from a single innovation into a complete sleep health company. We now design advanced diagnostic and treatment solutions, and we deliver care directly to patients through Dreem Health, our digital sleep clinic. By serving patients in all 50 states with reimbursed care, we are making sleep treatment more accessible, more personal, and much simpler than it has ever been.

Dreem Health is America's leading digital sleep clinic that's fixing the broken sleep care patient journey. We connect patients with sleep specialists through a straightforward telehealth platform, eliminating lengthy wait times and complicated in-lab testing. Our clinicians diagnose sleep disorders using home-based tests and deliver effective treatment plans that patients can easily follow.

Dreem Health is managed by the Sunrise Group, a breakthrough technology company that's revolutionizing sleep care with innovative diagnostic and treatment technologies, including a home sleep test that's changing how sleep apnea is diagnosed. Together, we're tackling one of healthcare's biggest challenges: helping the 1+ billion people affected by sleep disorders get the care they deserve. Backed by Amazon's Alexa Fund and $35M in funding, we're just getting started.

Your opportunity

As a Patient Care Coordinator at Dreem Health, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the patient experience from start to finish. You won’t just support our healthcare providers and answer patient inquiries — you’ll own key aspects of our service delivery, drive improvements based on real patient feedback, and help create the operational foundation for a fast-growing digital sleep clinic.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about patient care and wants to make a real impact on how care is delivered at scale. You’ll learn how to navigate a tech-enabled care environment, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and be part of building a better, more accessible future for sleep health. If you thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven setting and are excited to grow with a company that’s redefining care, we’d love to meet you.

What you bring

  • Previous experience in a patient/customer facing role
  • Familiarity with electronic medical records (EMR/EHR) or other healthcare database systems
  • Confidence navigating digital tools and multitasking in a fast-paced, dynamic and collaborative environment
  • Ability to work autonomously while interacting effectively with healthcare providers, sleep specialists, and external partners
  • Foundational understanding of billing processes and durable medical equipment (DME)
  • A genuine commitment to deliver high-quality patient care and contributing to better access and patient outcomes

What makes you stand out

  • Completion of a Medical Assistant program or equivalent healthcare experience
  • Strong understanding of healthcare insurances and referral processes
  • High level of empathy and understanding of patients' needs as you strive to provide exceptional patient service and support throughout their care journey.

Benefits that make a difference

  • Be part of an international team across the US, Paris, Belgium, and Vienna
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • 20 days PTO + 10 paid holidays + sick leave
  • FREE One Medical membership
  • Internet reimbursement

Our team values

At Dreem Health — and across Sunrise — we believe in keeping things clear and simple. We make sleep medicine more accessible by cutting through complexity and focusing on what truly matters: helping people sleep and feel better. We count on one another, building trust through dependable actions and authentic teamwork. And we always let the sun rise — leading with optimism, compassion, and the belief that better sleep unlocks a healthier, fuller life.

We value people, not just paper. Don't quite meet every qualification? Apply anyway! We're interested in your unique perspective and what you'll bring to our team. Tell us your story and why you're passionate about improving sleep health. Real-world experience, empathy, and a genuine desire to help patients often matter more than checking every box.

Compensation

$21.00 - $25.00

Compensation Range - Depending on Experience
$21—$25 USD

Dreem Health / Sunrise is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels included and respected. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

Annotation is what helps AI make sense of the world. As an annotator, you may be invited to take part in online projects such as rating AI-generated content, evaluating factual accuracy, or comparing responses — when projects are available.

While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Carefully review provided data (text, images, or videos);
  • Label or classify content based on project guidelines;
  • Identify and flag factually incorrect, sensitive, inappropriate, or unclear material.

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for candidates open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline;
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in any professional role;
  • Logical thinking, fact-checking and reasoning abilities;
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to understand and follow complex instructions;
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to ask clarifying questions when needed;
  • Genuine interest in technology and artificial intelligence;
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1+).

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project (when available) → Complete tasks → Get paid

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments;
  • Participate into advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio;
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $15/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate. Keep in mind, quality standards must be maintained, regardless of speed.
