raw.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Integration & JVM Ecosystem
raw.excerpt: About ClickHouseRecognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies.
raw.description:
About ClickHouse

Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and ARR that has grown over 250 percent year over year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company’s sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

The Connectors team is the bridge between ClickHouse and the entire data ecosystem. We build and maintain the connectors that make ClickHouse accessible to millions of developers and data practitioners worldwide. Our work spans from low-level database integrations to high-level data visualization plugins, ensuring that ClickHouse seamlessly integrates with the tools our users already know and love.

We're responsible for the official data connectors (Kafka, dbt, Spark, Flink, Beam, Fivetran), and integrations with leading visualization platforms (Grafana, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase).

What will you do?

As a Senior Software Engineer specializing in JVM-based frameworks, you'll serve as a core contributor, owning and maintaining critical parts of ClickHouse's Data engineering ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of high-performance database engineering and developer experience, where you'll craft tools that enable Data Engineers to harness ClickHouse's incredible speed and scale.

You'll own the full lifecycle of data framework integrations - from the core database driver that handles billions of records per second, to SDKs and connectors that make ClickHouse feel native in JVM-based applications. This isn't just about writing code; you're building the foundation that thousands of Data engineers rely on for their most critical data workloads.

Your work will directly impact how companies process massive datasets, from real-time analytics platforms ingesting millions of events per second to observability systems monitoring global infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with the open-source community, internal teams, and enterprise users to ensure our JVM integrations set the standard for performance, reliability, and developer experience.

About you:
  • 6+ years of software development experience focusing on building and delivering high-quality, data-intensive solutions.
  • Proven experience with the internals of streaming or data integration frameworks, with strong preference for Apache Kafka (or similar pub/sub systems), Kafka Connect, Apache Flink or Apache Beam.
  • Experience developing or extending connectors, sinks, or sources for at least one streaming processing framework such as Apache Flink, Beam, or Kafka Connect, with preference for experience building or maintaining production-grade streaming connectors.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka or similar distributed messaging systems (e.g., Pulsar, Kinesis), including topic design, consumer groups, and performance tuning.
  • Strong understanding of database fundamentals: SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and familiarity with OLAP/analytical databases.
A track record of building scalable data integration systems (beyond simple ETL jobs)
  • Strong proficiency in Java and the JVM ecosystem, including deep knowledge of memory management, garbage collection tuning, and performance profiling.
  • Solid experience with concurrent programming in Java, including threads, executors, and reactive or asynchronous patterns.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively within the team and across engineering functions.
  • Understanding of JDBC, network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP), and techniques for optimizing data throughput over the wire.
  • Passion for open-source development.
Bonus points for:
  • Prior contributions to open-source projects: actively engaging with the OSS community, advocating for users, and influencing the evolution of the core system through your contributions - big advantage.
  • Familiarity with ClickHouse or similar high-performance data platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Python, especially in data engineering contexts (e.g., Pandas, PySpark, Airflow), and ability to contribute to Python tooling when needed.

Compensation

For roles based in the United States, the typical starting salary range for this position is listed above. In certain locations, such as the San Francisco Bay Area and the New York City Metro Area, a premium market range may apply, as listed.

These salary ranges reflect what we reasonably and in good faith believe to be the minimum and maximum pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation may be higher or lower than the amounts listed, and the ranges may be subject to future adjustments.

An individual’s placement within the range will depend on various factors, including (but not limited to) education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location, performance, and the needs of the business or organization.

If you have any questions or comments about compensation as a candidate, please get in touch with us at .

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 20 countries.
  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
  • A $500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

  • Comfortable using digital platforms for secure communication (Abi will give you access to an easy-to-use application you can use from your phone anywhere and at any time).

  • Flexible work hours – pick up video consultations at your convenience, based on your own availability (no fixed scheduling needed).

  • Medical Team at your disposal to support you anytime.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise healthcare services. Apply now and become a valuable part of the Abi Global Health team. Together, let's make quality healthcare accessible to all.

Abi Global Health is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment for all employees.

Send your updated CV highlighting your relevant experience. We look forward to welcoming you to our dynamic team at Abi Global Health!

iT1, a leading national technology solution provider headquartered in Tempe, AZ, is looking for a skilled and experienced Senior Google Presales Engineer to join our team. iT1 has been ranked as one of Arizona’s Best Places to Work for over a decade, running in the Small Business category. You will be exposed to many of the top technology offerings in the market and can work with some of the most talented people in the country.

The Senior Google Presales Engineer is responsible for the presales of complex projects focusing on Google Workspace administration and AI Gemini enterprise deployment across all industry verticals to meet our client’s technology and business needs.

This role requires deep expertise in Google Workspace core services including Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Meet, Chat, and Docs, as well as advanced knowledge of Gemini Enterprise agentic AI platform for business workflows. Our engineering team consults with our sales team, project management team and clients to deploy highly technical solutions to help our clients achieve their business objectives. This person will be a subject matter expert for strategic client opportunities covering Google Workspace administration, AI agent development, data governance, security implementation, and enterprise-grade AI deployment.

  • Expertise and interest in staying current around new Google Workspace solutions and Gemini AI capabilities.

  • Deploy and manage Gemini Enterprise agentic AI platform for enterprise search, analysis, and workflow automation.
  • Create and manage AI agents using Agent Designer (no-code) and Agent Development Kit (ADK) for custom enterprise applications.
  • Implement data governance policies including data loss prevention rules in Gmail and Drive to prevent data leakage.
  • Configure security policies including two-step verification, password policies, and access controls to govern user access.
  • Manage endpoint devices and mobile device management policies for enterprise compliance.
  • Configure identity providers and OAuth consent screens for secure application integration.
  • Create and manage Google Drive and Google Calendar data stores for Gemini Enterprise apps.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security features including VPC Service Controls, Private Service Connect, and customer-managed encryption keys.
  • Strong understanding of Google Workspace architecture, data grounding, and AI agent orchestration.

  • Troubleshoot common Google Workspace and Gemini Enterprise deployment issues.

  • 5-8 years in a project delivery role with focus on cloud collaboration platforms.
  • 5-8 years of Google Workspace implementation and administration experience.
  • 3-5 years of experience with Google Workspace migrations from legacy email and collaboration systems.
  • 3-5 years of success in consulting on complex technical projects, including design and planning, implementation and deployment, and support.
  • Experience managing and supporting Google Workspace in an enterprise environment with 1,000+ users.
  • Experience administering organizational units, group policies, and resource management in Google Admin console.
  • Experience deploying and managing AI solutions in enterprise environments, particularly Gemini Enterprise or similar agentic AI platforms.
  • Experience with data governance, compliance configuration, and security policy implementation in Google Workspace.
  • Experience with endpoint management and mobile device policies in enterprise settings.
  • Exhibit a proactive, process-oriented, and results-driven mentality.
  • Experience in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to prioritize and organize effectively.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work both independently and with others.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, team-oriented, collaborative environment with tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in using Google Workspace applications and collaboration tools.
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing technologies, AI and machine learning fundamentals, and emerging trends in enterprise AI.

  • Professional Google Workspace Administrator
  • Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
  • Google AI Professional Certificate

​What does it mean to work at Armstrong?

It means being immersed in a supportive culture that recognizes you as a key player in Armstrong's future. We are a large company with a local feel, where you will get to know and collaborate with leadership and your colleagues across the company.

By joining us, you'll have the opportunity to make the most of your potential. Alongside a competitive remuneration package, you will receive:

A benefits package including: medical, dental, prescription drug, life insurance, 401k match, long-term disability coverage, vacation and sick time, product discount programs and many more.

A working culture that balances individual achievement with teamwork and collaboration. We draw on each other's strengths and allow for different work styles to build engagement and satisfaction to deliver results.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Energy Savings Ceilings, we're seeking an East Regional Energy Savings Customer Success Manager who will support the execution of Energy Saving Ceilings (ESC) growth within a defined geography. This role serves as the regional concierge for customers and sales teams, driving customers through the decision funnel and ensuring a smooth, informed path to “yes.” This role combines customer advocacy, market intelligence, and commercial execution.

This is a hands-on execution role, focused on working with Architects & Designers (A&D), contractors, subcontractors, and distributors. The role partners closely with regional sales to identify opportunities, monitor active opportunities, remove barriers, and help convert interest into orders.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and persistent - someone who enjoys working directly with customers, coordinating across teams, and keeping projects moving.

What You’ll Do

Customer & Project Execution

  • Serve as the regional customer concierge — identify what customers need to move forward and coordinate internal resources to deliver it.
  • Support existing customer groups (A&D, contractors, subcontractors, distributors) throughout design and project development.
  • Monitor key regional projects and opportunity progress to ensure timely follow-up and engagement.
  • Help remove obstacles that may delay customer decisions or project advancement.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce (SFDC) and support sales enablement efforts.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve the customer journey and drive measurable conversion outcomes.

Sales Partnership

  • Partner closely with regional sales teams to identify opportunities, align on priorities, project status, and next actions.
  • Support customer meetings, follow-ups, and information requests that help move projects toward specification and order.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project and customer activity in Salesforce (SFDC).

Customer Insight & Feedback

  • Capture and share Voice of Customer (VOC) insights, including common questions, barriers, and competitive dynamics.
  • Identify patterns in regional activity and elevate insights to the broader ESC team.

Coordination & Cross-Functional Support

  • Coordinate with technical, product, incentives, and operations teams to ensure customers receive timely and accurate information.
  • Support regional training, events, or customer engagement activities as needed.
  • Help improve execution processes that enhance the overall customer experience.

What will make you successful

  • Working knowledge and experience in construction, contracting, distribution, specification sales, commercial building products, and knowledge of market segments, customers, and distribution channels.
  • Experience working in or supporting the design and construction ecosystem (A&D, contractor, distributor, or building products environment) preferred.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) or similar CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Excellent communication and follow-through.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with field sales and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience in customer success, sales support, project coordination, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of outside sales experience working with architects, distributors, or owners.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • High school diploma/GED required.

What You Bring

  • Positive Energy: You bring enthusiasm and optimism to customer and team interactions.
  • Relentless Persistence: You follow through and keep projects moving until issues are resolved.
  • Curiosity: You ask questions to understand customer needs and challenges.
  • Adaptability: You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving environment.
  • Collaboration: You partner effectively with sales and internal teams to deliver strong customer outcomes.

Why should you join Armstrong World Industries?

Armstrong World Industries (AWI) is an Americas leader in the design and manufacture of innovative interior and exterior architectural applications including ceilings, specialty walls and exterior metal solutions. With approximately $1.4 billion in revenue, AWI has about 3,700 employees and a manufacturing network of 21 facilities in North America.

At home, at work, in healthcare facilities, classrooms, stores, or restaurants, we offer interior solutions that help to enhance comfort, save time, improve building efficiency and overall performance, and create beautiful spaces.

For more than 160 years, we have built our business on trust and integrity. It set us apart then, and it sets us apart now, along with our ability to collaborate with and innovate for the people we're here to serve - our customers, our shareholders, our communities and our employees.

We are committed to developing new and sustainable architectural solutions, with design and performance possibilities that make a positive difference in spaces where we live, work, learn, heal and play. It's an exciting, rewarding business to be in, and we're committed to continue to grow and prosper for the benefit of all of our stakeholders. We hope you join us.

Our Sustainability Ambition

"Bringing our Purpose to Life" - lead a transformation in the design and building of spaces fit for today and tomorrow.

We are committed to:

  • Engaging a diverse, purpose-driven workforce;
  • Transforming buildings from structures that shelter into structures that serve and preserve the health and well-being of people and planet;
  • Pursuing sustainable, innovative solutions for spaces where we live, work, learn heal and play;
  • Being a catalyst for change with all of our stakeholders; and
  • Making a positive difference in the environments and communities we impact.

About the location (Lancaster PA)

Lancaster, PA. A great central location in South Central Pennsylvania, Lancaster is ideally situated for easy access to major metropolitan cities such as Philadelphia, Baltimore, Washington DC, and New York City. Description

Company Overview:

Cellebrite’s (Nasdaq: CLBT) mission is to enable its global customers to protect and save lives by enhancing digital investigations and intelligence gathering to accelerate justice in communities around the world. Cellebrite’s AI-powered Digital Investigation Platform enables customers to lawfully access, collect, analyze and share digital evidence in legally sanctioned investigations while preserving data privacy. Thousands of public safety organizations, intelligence agencies and businesses rely on Cellebrite’s digital forensic and investigative solutions-available via cloud, on-premises and hybrid deployments-to close faster and safeguard communities.

To learn more, visit us at www.cellebrite.com,  and find us on social media @Cellebrite.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a talented and driven developer to join our Corellium team and contribute to the development of scalable, cloud-native AI solutions on AWS. This role focuses on building and maintaining infrastructure and services that support advanced machine learning workflows, real-time inference, and robust observability.

You will research and build data-driven applications. Research and develop Machine Learning algorithms to turn forensic data into investigation leads, evidence, and intelligence insights. Be a part of a heterogeneous, multi-disciplinary research team. Take projects end to end, from the inception of the idea, through data and algorithm research and POC development. The work is both analytical and experimental in nature and includes prototyping of new algorithms, investigating data, and evaluating algorithm performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement features for our AWS-based AI solution, including job orchestration, manifest generation, and API integrations.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, CDK, and AWS infrastructure (e.g., SageMaker, Lambda, Bedrock).
  • Ensure code quality and reliability through comprehensive unit testing, performance testing, and observability enhancements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI services into broader investigation workflows and runtime environments.
  • Troubleshoot deployment issues and contribute to the continuous improvement of dashboards and monitoring tools.

Requirements:

  • Proficiency in Python and Typescript, with experience in API development and cloud-native architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services including SageMaker, Lambda, etc.
  • Experience with machine learning libraries such as PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, and related data processing tools.
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable code and contribute to shared documentation and best practices.
  • Familiarity with GitHub workflows, secrets management, and secure deployment practices.
  • Familiarity with Amazon EKS and Kubernetes-based deployments.
  • Experience with GenAI infrastructure, semantic caching, and LLM integration.
  • Knowledge of observability tools like Datadog and log aggregation strategies
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

The Infra Foundations team owns the foundational layer that every other infrastructure team builds on: AWS account provisioning, human IAM access, core networking, the IaC frameworks and workflows, and the automation that provisions and manages our cloud environments. Our mission is to provide a foundational infrastructure layer across all AWS accounts that is consistent, reliable, safe, and trustworthy, empowering every infrastructure team to provision, update, and delete their stacks quickly and safely through well-established workflows and automation.

We are looking for an engineering manager to lead this team, own its roadmap and operational health, and grow the engineers who keep Affirm's infrastructure foundation solid as we scale globally.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and drive the vision and multi-quarter roadmap, tying foundational investments to critical, business-impacting outcomes while protecting space for tech-debt reduction and reliability work
  • Lead and mentor a team of infrastructure engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and technical excellence, and owning hiring, performance, and career growth
  • Partner with engineering leadership and stakeholders to align Infra Foundations priorities with broader infrastructure, platform, and security goals
  • Own the reliability and safety of the foundational layer: AWS account provisioning and bootstrapping, core networking (VPCs and interconnectivity), and human IAM access
  • Drive the team's automation charter, delivering frameworks that let other infra teams provision, update, and tear down complex stacks and whole environments safely on the existing IaC rails (GitHub, Spacelift)
  • Steward critical operational programs including AWS quota management and notifications, AMI patch management, and Ansible-based configuration management
  • Establish and hold the operational bar: SLAs for IAM requests, quota alerting thresholds, incident response for networking changes, and automated validation of provisioning and teardown
  • Partner with Security to enforce least-privilege IAM and ensure recommended permissions are adopted across teams
  • Drive smooth adoption of Infra Foundations frameworks and best practices through self-service tooling, documentation, and knowledge sharing

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of software or infrastructure engineering experience, with 2+ years of engineering management experience
  • Proven experience leading engineering teams in infrastructure, platform engineering, or adjacent domains
  • Strong technical background in cloud-native and infrastructure systems (AWS preferred), with the ability to guide architecture and execution across accounts, VPC networking, and IAM
  • Experience owning or leading Infrastructure-as-Code practices (Terraform, Spacelift, or equivalent) and GitOps-style workflows
  • Experience building and operating infrastructure automation that other teams adopt and depend on
  • Track record of operating services with a high reliability bar (monitoring, on-call, incident response, postmortems, continuous hardening)
  • Strong operational judgment and the ability to drive clarity, prioritization, and execution across a broad, heterogeneous surface area
  • Familiarity with least-privilege IAM models and partnering with Security on access governance
  • Strong programming background (Python, Go, or Kotlin preferred)
  • Strong communication and organizational leadership skills, with a track record of mentoring and growing high-performing teams
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience

raw.description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for an Incentive Compensation Systems Manager to join our Incentive Compensation (IC) team and drive the systemization, automation, and continuous improvement of our commission operations. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, reporting to the Senior Manager, Incentive Compensation. To be successful, you should look forward to operating in an unstructured, fast-paced, remote-first environment where you will identify gaps in existing processes, replace manual workarounds with scalable systems, and bring greater predictability, accuracy, and speed to how the business manages commissions, quotas, and comp plan administration.

In this role, you will gain deep exposure to how incentive compensation data flows end-to-end from our CRM (e.g., SFDC), People systems (e.g., Workday) through calculation engines (e.g., Xactly) to payout and reporting (e.g., BigQuery). You'll be the person the team turns to when a process is slow, fragile, or held together by spreadsheets. You will partner closely with our Incentive Compensation Operations Team, Finance & Strategy, People Ops, and RevOps orgs to understand how work actually gets done today, find the friction points, and build the tooling and workflows that remove them. This role requires a unique balance: enough technical depth to design and build real automation, combined with the process discipline and cross-functional judgment to know which problems are worth solving first.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Process & Gap Assessment: Embed with the IC team to map current-state workflows across plan administration, calculation, approvals, and payout. Identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone steps and prioritize them based on risk, time cost, and business impact.
  • Systematization & Automation: Design and build automated workflows, integrations, and tooling that replace manual processes from data pulls and reconciliations to approval routing and exception handling. Reduce reliance on ad-hoc spreadsheets and one-off scripts in favor of durable, repeatable systems.
  • Xactly ICM Ownership: Serve as a hands-on owner of our Xactly instances (e.g., Incent and Connect) configuring calculation rules, plan logic, and workflows, and continuously tuning the platform so it does more of the heavy lifting currently done manually outside the system.
  • AI-Enabled Process Automation: Identify where AI tools and LLM-driven agents can take over manual, repetitive Incentive Compensation work such as exception detection, data reconciliation, plan document review, or answering common comp questions and build the workflows/integrations to put them into production.
  • Systems Integration: Partner with IC, Finance & Strategy, People Ops, Revenue Operations, and IT/Data teams to ensure incentive compensation systems are properly integrated, with clean, reliable data flowing between them.
  • Documentation & Governance: Establish clear documentation, standard operating procedures, and controls for newly systematized processes, so they're auditable, maintainable, and don't regress back into manual work over time.
  • Continuous Improvement Cadence: Set up a repeatable process for the IC team to keep identifying and retiring manual work, as an ongoing discipline of finding the next bottleneck and fixing it.
  • Cross-Functional Enablement: Act as the go-to resource translating IC process needs into system requirements, and translating system/data constraints back into practical process recommendations the team can act on.
  • Operational Excellence: Support urgent, ad-hoc requests during payout cycles while keeping an eye on the long-term goal. Building yourself out of the fire-fighting role by systemizing the fixes.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in incentive compensation, sales operations, revenue operations, or a related systems/process improvement role. Experience in a fast-paced technology or SaaS business is highly preferred.
  • Process Improvement Mindset: A demonstrated track record of finding manual, broken, or inefficient processes and systematizing them, not just documenting problems but building the solution.
  • SQL & Data Fluency: Hands-on SQL experience and comfort querying and reconciling data across systems to diagnose process gaps and validate automated outputs.
  • Automation & Tooling: Hands-on experience building automated workflows using tools such as scripting, workflow/RPA platforms, or ICM systems (e.g., Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, SPIFF platforms). Comfort standing up lightweight tools or integrations when off-the-shelf options fall short.
  • Systems Fluency: Familiarity with the core systems that touch incentive compensation: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), HRIS, data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery), and comp management platforms (e.g., Xactly) understanding how data moves between them.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Strong communication skills, with the ability to sit with a team, understand how they actually work day-to-day, and translate that into clear systems requirements and process changes.
  • Analytical Rigor: Understanding of core comp mechanics (quotas, accelerators, SPIFFs, payout timing) sufficient to spot where a process breaks down or introduces risk.

Bonus Points For:

  • Industry & Scale Context: Experience working in a high-growth SaaS, cloud, or open-source company, particularly within a public company or an environment undergoing IPO readiness.
  • Global Collaboration: Proven success working within globally distributed, remote-first organizations across multiple time zones.
  • AI & LLM-Driven Automation: Experience documenting datasets and workflows for Model Context Protocol (MCP) server ingestion, or building AI skills/agents to automate incentive compensation data discovery, exception detection, or reporting.

Compensation and Rewards:

In Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $145,000 - $175,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

raw.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesThe Peraton Health, State and Local Sector is seeking Cobol Software Developers to join us in supporting and maintaining the Medicare Fee For Service claims processing system.
raw.description:
Responsibilities

The Peraton Health, State and Local Sector is seeking Cobol Software Developers to join us in supporting and maintaining the Medicare Fee For Service claims processing system. In this role, you will be a contributing member of an Agile team providing maintenance and operations support for the Durable Medical Equipment (DME) contract.

As a Cobol Software Developer, you will work within a highly structured and rigorous development environment that follows the SAFe Agile/Scrum framework. This position offers an opportunity to build foundational engineering skills while supporting a critical healthcare platform. You will work primarily with mainframe technologies, including COBOL and JCL, to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions.

You will assist in designing, developing, and enhancing software programs according to established procedures and coding standards. You will also build and execute unit test plans, test cases, and test data to ensure high-quality deliverables.

You will collaborate closely with your team to plan and execute work assignments, ensuring all project due dates and sprint commitments are met. Additionally, you will help install software changes into internal testing regions, troubleshoot and resolve discovered defects, and assist in keeping technical documentation current.

What you'll do:   

  • Designs, codes, unit tests, and debugs enhancements and fixes to the health claims processing system.
  • Participates as a member of a persistent Agile development team supporting maintenance and operations.
  • Completes development to implement components of moderate complexity under general direction within a legacy mainframe environment.
  • Participates in design activities related to maintenance solutions.
  • Demonstrates general use and application of concepts, practices, and techniques.
  • Designs, prepares and executes unit tests to validate changes prior to release, and represents team to clients.
  • Provides solutions to a variety of technical problems.
  • Applies technical knowledge to deliver maintenance solutions across one or more technology areas.
  • Applies company and 3rd party technologies solutions of moderate complexity with general direction.
  • With only general direction, implements end-user or enterprise solutions of moderate complexity with general direction provided.
  • Integrates technical expertise and business understanding to deliver stable, reliable solutions for clients.
  • Consults with team members and other organizations, clients, and vendors on technical issues.
  • Provides time and resource estimates for assigned tasks and projects.
  • Assists in developing solutions to complex business and technology problems in areas of proven expertise. 

Qualifications

What you'll need:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • Education & Experience: 0-2 years with BS/BA, or a High School diploma with 4 years of experience.
  • Experience with mainframe technologies such as COBOL, JCL, CICS, TSO and VSAM.
  • Ability to perform well in a highly rigorous structured development environment.
  • Demonstrated experience as a software developer in a mainframe environment, preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to determine and decompose business and technical requirements.
  • Experience with application lifecycle methodology experience, specifically Agile/SCRUM.
  • Strong communication skills and technical writing ability.
  • Ability to develop application project solutions and provide accurate estimates.
  • Must be able to achieve and maintain Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

 

  • Knowledge of health care claims processing, particularly Medicare Fee For Service.
  • 2 years of mainframe development experience.
  • Experience with Medicare Part A, Medicare Part B, DME or Medicare Common Working File (CWF) specific processing systems.
  • Experience working with or in support of CMS programs or contracts.
  • Experience with DevOps/DevSecOps tools and frameworks through plan, define, build, test, release and deploy processes.
  • SAFe Agile experience and/or certification.
  • Experience with Assembler language in a mainframe environment.
  • Familiarity with development and collaboration tools: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Eclipse (IDz/RDz).
  • Exposure to modern languages such as Java or Python.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

Who You Are

As you start your career in sales, you thrive on taking initiative and have a hunter mentality when it comes to uncovering opportunities. You’re growth-minded, driven, and excited to kick-start your sales career at a fast-growing tech company. Partnering closely with our Account Executives, Growth team, and fellow BDRs, you’ll play a pivotal role in building a robust pipeline of qualified leads. You'll have an amazing opportunity to kick-off your sales career in a growing tech company and receive mentorship from seasoned sales professionals.

What you will do

  • Strategic Prospecting: Leverage tools and tech to identify potential clients, key decision-makers, and build targeted prospect lists
  • Cold Calling & Outreach: Proactively engage prospects through strategic outbound calls, personalized emails, and social media outreach
  • Discovery & Qualification: Conduct discovery calls to convert prospects into sales-qualified leads (SQLs) and book meetings for our Account Executives
  • Pipeline Growth: Nurture and engage with key accounts through relevant social media channels
  • CRM Management: Track all activities, maintain detailed notes, and ensure accurate data entry in our CRM (HubSpot)
  • Product Knowledge: Stay up-to-date on Cardata’s products and services to effectively communicate value to prospects

What you bring

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage prospects confidently
  • A growth mindset and a highly motivated, self-starter attitude with a passion for cold calling and driving results
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills to connect with prospects effectively
  • Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to manage time and prioritize multiple tasks effectively
  • Enthusiasm for pursuing a career in sales and a willingness to learn and grow in a dynamic environment

Nice to have

  • Experience in sales, particularly SaaS or tech sales

  • Knowledge of outbound prospecting tools like Zoominfo, HubSpot, or similar platforms

Compensation

In line with Ontario’s Pay Transparency legislation, the expected base compensation for this role is $50,000-55,000 CAD annually, with additional earning potential of $10,000-30,000 depending on performance. Actual earnings are dependent on experience, skills, and performance. This is a vacant position, and we are hiring with intention and seeking someone who will bring new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

All candidates will be equally considered without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, language, citizenship, creed, religion, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, physical and/or mental handicap or financial ability. raw.excerpt: Sobre a ZippiEstamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.
raw.description:
Sobre a Zippi

Estamos na missão de impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades.

Desde o nosso lançamento, há quatro anos, alcançamos a lucratividade e vivemos um período de crescimento exponencial. Até hoje, já concedemos mais de R$ 10 bilhões em crédito para micro e pequenos negócios em todo o Brasil. Estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de capital de giro no mercado brasileiro de MPBs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 3,5 trilhões por ano.

Nosso sucesso é impulsionado por uma abordagem altamente automatizada e baseada em dados. Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, formamos um time de tecnologia de calibre global focado em construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar.

Sobre o Time

O Jurídico da Zippi está em um momento especialmente interessante de construção. Somos um time enxuto, responsável por apoiar o crescimento de uma fintech que opera em um ambiente jurídico complexo e regulado.

Com a expansão da Zippi, o volume e a diversidade das demandas jurídicas também cresceram — e estamos estruturando o time para acompanhar esse próximo capítulo. Isso significa que quem entrar agora encontrará uma área ainda em formação, com proximidade das decisões, exposição a diferentes frentes jurídicas e espaço real para ajudar a construir processos, nossa operação e formas de trabalhar desde cedo.

Sua Missão

Sua missão será se tornar uma peça-chave na construção da operação jurídica da Zippi, começando por três frentes centrais — contencioso, contratos e suporte consultivo às áreas internas — e ganhando autonomia progressiva sobre elas.

No dia a dia, você vai acompanhar uma carteira de processos cíveis e consumeristas em parceria com nosso escritório externo — incluindo o acompanhamento de casos junto a órgãos como PROCON e —, conduzir contratos comerciais de menor complexidade do início ao fim e apoiar times como Produto, Operações e People na resolução de dúvidas jurídicas recorrentes.

Mais do que executar essas rotinas, esperamos que você ajude a torná-las cada vez mais organizadas, eficientes e escaláveis: estruturando controles, acompanhando métricas, identificando lacunas e propondo melhorias nos processos em operação — inclusive com uso de IA e automações para reduzir trabalho manual e ganhar escala.

À medida que ganha domínio e autonomia nessas frentes, existe espaço para ampliar sua atuação para temas como trabalhista, compliance, privacidade e projetos de automação, construindo uma visão generalista do Jurídico de uma fintech em crescimento e assumindo progressivamente novas responsabilidades dentro do time.

O que buscamos:

  • OAB ativa (ou fase final de obtenção, ex.: aprovado(a) no exame aguardando emissão do número).
  • Base em contencioso cível: experiência elaborando subsídios/peças, acompanhando prazos processuais e organizando documentação, idealmente com responsabilidade sobre uma carteira, ainda que pequena.
  • Experiência emrevisão de contratos: prestação de serviços, NDAs, aditivos ou fornecedores.
  • Autonomia operacional: resolve e sinaliza proativamente quando trava, sem depender de instrução passo a passo — inclusive para identificar e apontar gaps ou inconsistências por conta própria.
  • Boa capacidade de execução: entende e se interessa por um escopo majoritariamente prático.
  • Curiosidade e iniciativa para usar IA e automações na melhoria de fluxos e rotinas jurídicas, buscando reduzir trabalho manual e tornar os processos mais eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas jurídicas (Elaw, DocuSign/ZapSign, Notion) ou facilidade para se adaptar a elas

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Exposição a trabalhista/People (contratos CLT/PJ, rescisões, políticas internas);
  • Familiaridade com temas de compliance, KYC/AML ou LGPD.
  • Contexto prévio em empresa regulada (fintech, crédito, meios de pagamento);
  • Experiência em consultivo interno a áreas de negócio (Produto, Operações, Comercial, People);
  • Regulatório Bacen/CVM/FIDC

Por que vir para a Zippi?

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar: nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
  • Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia: como early team member, você terá papel essencial na evolução e construção do Jurídico de uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada por investidores de renome como Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Globo Ventures e Volpe Capital.
  • Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa: aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta.

O que você pode esperar da gente!

  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Learning Budget anual;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros(as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade;
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos;
  • Vale-refeição no Caju;
  • Férias flexíveis;
  • Wellhub e Zenklub;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto.

DataDome is looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our US team.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will partner with Account Executives and prospective customers to define technical strategy, uncover business and security challenges, and demonstrate how DataDome can protect critical digital experiences.

You will own the technical motion across discovery, architecture discussions, demonstrations, proof-of-value exercises, security reviews, and technical close. You will work with security, engineering, infrastructure, and executive stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, leading customer conversations, and becoming a trusted technical advisor throughout the buying process.

DataDome delivers real-time bot and agent trust management, giving businesses complete visibility and control over all traffic—human, bot, or AI. Named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Bot And Agent Trust Management Q2 2026, DataDome is trusted by enterprises like Etsy, PayPal, and Soundcloud. Acting as a traffic control plane, DataDome's multi-layered AI engine leverages thousands of models and 5 trillion signals daily to analyze intent and stop fraud in under 2 milliseconds—letting legitimate users through seamlessly across websites, apps, APIs, and MCPs. Backed by a 24/7 SOC and expert threat researchers, DataDome stops 20k+ attacks every second. With 30+ global PoPs, and 80+ ready-made integrations, DataDome is a recognized Leader on G2 across several categories—delivering protection that outperforms.

What you will do

  • Own the technical strategy for mid-market and enterprise opportunities from discovery through technical close.
  • Understand customer business challenges, security priorities, application architecture, traffic flows, and success criteria.
  • Lead technical discovery and architecture discussions with engineering, security, infrastructure, and executive stakeholders.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling product demonstrations, workshops, technical presentations, and proof-of-value exercises.
  • Design and validate DataDome deployment approaches across web, mobile, API, CDN, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Guide prospects through technical evaluations, integrations, testing, security reviews, and production-readiness discussions.
  • Configure and analyze trial environments to validate DataDome’s detection and mitigation capabilities.
  • Analyze traffic, logs, detection outcomes, and customer requirements to recommend effective solutions.
  • Partner closely with Account Management, Sales, Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and Marketing.
  • Help identify and overcome technical, security, and business objections.

We're looking for a Total Rewards Analyst to help us design and deliver compensation and benefits experiences that are equitable, data-informed, and deeply employee-centered.

You'll play a key role in supporting and evolving our global compensation programs and benefits offerings, ensuring they're not only competitive in the market but truly meaningful to the people who receive them. You'll be hands-on with operations, data, and tools that help ensure our programs run smoothly, moving fluidly between compensation cycles and benefits administration as the team's needs shift. You'll work closely with senior members of the team and cross-functional partners, taking ownership of defined processes across both disciplines. You'll also help us build scalable operations through automation and documentation so the impact of your work is felt well beyond the day-to-day.

About the role:

  • Location: Remote-first (United States)
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.

    • United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • Zone A: $125,000 - $150,000
      • Zone B: $118,000 - $142,000
      • Zone C: $110,000 - $132,000

This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals.

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position
  • Reporting to the Sr. Director, Total Rewards

As a Total Rewards Analyst, you'll work on…

  • Compensation Analysis & Support
    • Administer assigned elements of the annual and mid-year compensation cycles, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of system updates, testing, and training/announcement materials.
    • Conduct job pricing using standardized methodologies as part of our market benchmarking process.
    • Maintain pay ranges and support job mapping and internal equity analysis as part of pay structure upkeep.
    • Support pay equity audits and data validation activities under guidance from senior team members, maintaining audit-ready documentation.
    • Serve as a first escalation point to employee compensation questions submitted through People Help tickets, escalating complex issues as needed.
  • Benefits Administration
    • Administer day-to-day benefits administration such as enrollments, terminations, life events, and audits within established SOPs and SLAs, including with international benefit providers.
    • Own assigned components of Open Enrollment and renewal cycles, ensuring accurate execution and documentation.
    • Coordinate with vendors on eligibility files, audits, and issue resolution, escalating as needed.
    • Drive routine Leave of Absence (LOA) processing and data updates, ensuring payroll and benefits accuracy during leave.
    • Support compliance activities (ACA, COBRA, and other statutory programs) under guidance, maintaining audit-ready records.
    • Communicate benefits information clearly and empathetically; serve as a first escalation point to employee benefits questions submitted through People Help tickets, escalating complex issues as needed.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
    • Maintain compensation and benefits data accuracy across Workday, payroll, and vendor systems, running audits and correcting discrepancies.
    • Generate standard reports and dashboards supporting compensation cycles and benefits metrics.
    • Assist in identifying simple patterns in the data that could point to inconsistencies or opportunities for improvement.
    • Own compensation and benefits survey submissions, including internal-to-external job mapping.
  • Operational Excellence & Automation
    • Build and maintain basic automated workflows (e.g., Zapier, Cowork) to help the team run more smoothly.
    • Keep process documentation current and organized so others can follow established protocols easily.
    • Suggest ways to improve our processes using automation or AI tools, with support from more senior team members on implementation.

About you:

Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of experience in compensation, benefits, or total rewards, especially in a global and/or remote company.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, attention to detail, and are highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Familiar with HRIS systems and compensation/benefits management tools such as Workday, Pave, and Radford.
  • Experience with AI and automation tools like ChatGPT, Claude Cowork/Chat, and Zapier

You'll thrive as a Total Rewards Analyst if you:

  • Can apply sound judgment within established SOPs and know when to escalate — this role owns defined processes with edge cases, not fully autonomous program design.
  • Excel in communication and can work effectively and collaboratively across diverse teams including other People teams, Finance, Payroll, Sales, and Legal.
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

About the role:

We're looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Payable Specialist to run the day-to-day of 8am's AP process on our Procure-to-Pay team. Reporting to the Accounts Payable Manager, you'll handle vendor invoices, payments, purchase orders, and expense reimbursements with a sharp eye for accuracy and a strong service mindset. This is a hands-on role: you'll process transactions, resolve vendor issues, and support month-end close to keep AP accurate, timely, and audit-ready.

About us:

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

Founded in 2005, 8am™ (formerly AffiniPay) is the professional business platform built to help legal, accounting, and other client-focused professionals run stronger, more profitable businesses. Today, more than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. trust 8am to help them work smarter, serve clients better, and unlock their full potential. We have been recognized as one of Inc 5000’s fastest growing companies in the U.S. for 13 years in a row, and as a result, our teams continue to grow as well!

What you'll do:

  • Process vendor invoices and purchase orders with accurate coding, approvals, and timely payments.
  • Research and resolve credit balances and payment discrepancies with vendors.
  • Handle stale-dated check research, stop payments, voids, and reissuance.
  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for vendors on payments and payment terms.
  • Process employee expense reports and support the corporate card and charity matching programs.
  • Support month-end close, monthly AP reporting, and annual 1099 processing.
  • Keep AP files audit-ready and flag process gaps to the AP Manager.
  • Use AI tools to automate invoice processing, coding, and vendor correspondence.

About you:

  • 1 to 3 years in accounts payable or accounting operations.
  • Excellent Excel skills and strong Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Strong communicator across all levels of the organization.
  • Responsive customer service instincts with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Self-starter who can juggle urgent requests without losing accuracy.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate or optimize your workflows.
  • Bonus: Bachelor's in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience, and multicurrency entity experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.

Diversity, equity & inclusion at 8am:

At 8am, we recognize that innovation occurs with a strong team of people who are diverse in background, personality, talent and ideas. Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Why 8am

At 8am, our culture is shaped by the people who bring it to life every day. Together, we build a company rooted in continuous learning, genuine community, holistic wellness, and meaningful engagement—values that empower us as individuals and unite us as a team. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Work Smart, Win Fast; Outshine Ordinary, and We Find a Way. These values drive how we serve our customers and work with each other in a collaborative, inspiring, and empowering environment, every day.

raw.excerpt: Location: Remote (UK or Europe) Department: Product & Technology The OpportunityThis role is for someone who shapes what's worth building, designs it by building, and owns the result in production.
raw.description:
Location: Remote (UK or Europe) Department: Product & Technology

The Opportunity

This role is for someone who shapes what's worth building, designs it by building, and owns the result in production. You explore and prototype like a designer, then carry the strong ideas all the way to a shipped front-end - one craft, not two stages with a handoff between them.

When the same person designs and builds, there's no spec to hand off and no rebuild cycle: the work moves faster and the original intent survives. You'll sit in a product squad alongside software engineers who own the systems beneath the experience. They're accountable for whether it runs; you're accountable for what it is.

Most of what gets called "AI in product" is a button bolted onto an unchanged screen. Our client is building the opposite: experiences where the agent does the work and the human reviews, corrects, and authorises it. Knowing the difference - and being able to ship it - is the judgment we're hiring for.

What You'll Do

  • Explore and prototype to find the right answer. Most of what you make is for learning, not shipping. Production is where the right answer lands, not where it starts.
  • Carry features through to the production front-end. The design decision and the code are the same job, in the same hands.
  • Help frame what's worth building. Talk to users, pressure-test problems, and shape scope with your squad rather than waiting for a finished spec.
  • Build the supervisory surfaces of an agent-native platform: a triage queue an underwriter trusts at a glance, a confidence and citation pattern they can act on, a briefing that replaces a dashboard.
  • Use AI across the full loop - research, design, prototype, build, test - as the default way you work, applying real judgment to its output rather than trusting it.
  • Own the invisible craft: performance, accessibility, cross-device behaviour, and the responsiveness that makes an interface feel fast.

What We're Looking For

  • A builder who designs and ships front-end to production. You've owned a problem, made the call on what the experience should be, and shipped it yourself.
  • Design judgment and taste. When AI produces competent interfaces instantly, telling good from merely functional is the scarce skill.
  • Product instinct. You can cut scope without being told to and validate with real users rather than waiting for certainty.
  • Fluency in a modern web codebase, with AI tooling at every stage. You know AI's failure modes and can tell when output looks right but isn't. We care that you can ship and know when it's right, not which framework you came up on.
  • The ability to design data-rich, high-stakes interfaces for demanding professionals, and to converse credibly with seasoned insurance experts.

There's no single right background - strong candidates come from design, from engineering, and from places in between. If you design and you build and you can ship both well, we want to talk.

Our core focus is to help patients get access to the life-changing medical innovations they need through our engaging, authentic storytelling.

Our big, hairy, audacious goal? Help bring 150 life-changing medical innovations to patients who need them by 2034. And everyone on our team is deeply committed to the cause with team tenure ranging from four years to eleven years!

What This Role Actually Is

You are the internal subject matter expert and narrative lead on each project.

This is a client facing role where you develop and own the story end-to-end — from needs assessment, pre-script writing, pre-production, on set interviews, through post production and editing.

You are responsible for shaping the narrative before the shoot, directing and adapting it in real time during interviews, and ensuring the story comes together clearly and accurately in the final edit.

Approximately 60% of this role focuses on clinician-facing content and 40% on patient-centered storytelling.

You will:

· Listen to clients explain their business problem and learn as much as you can about the medical innovation and disease states they support

· Learn from clinicians who explain how they use the innovation, which features and benefits matter to them, and how it benefits patients.

· Interview patients with compassion and understanding of their unique situations

· Speak and write in a way that earns respect and understanding from clinicians as well as be able to switch gears/TOV into patient-facing storytelling, depending on the audience.

What We’re Really Looking For

You are someone who:

· Understands and has some end-to-end experience with the corporate/branded documentary film production process

· Can quickly learn complex medical and engineering innovation topics and explain them clearly

· Is both analytical and emotionally intelligent

· Is outgoing and warm, comfortable engaging in conversations with clients, experts, and patients alike

· Has demonstrated the ability write compelling interview-driven scripts.

· Thrives in ambiguity and can create structure

What You’ll Do

This role requires ownership across the full storytelling lifecycle:

1.) Learn Fast, Go Deep

  • Independently research and synthesize complex medical topics—often with limited public information—so you can engage clients and clinicians as a credible, informed partner from the very first conversation

2.) Discovery & Client Partnership

  • Lead early discovery conversations with clients to understand the business problem

  • Translate client goals into clear storytelling strategies

3. Shape the Story Concept Before Production

Work with clients to define:

  • audiences (clinicians/patients/employees)

  • messaging

  • creative strategy

  • Conduct in-depth pre-interviews to uncover emotional truth, narrative arcs, and key story beats—not just facts

  • In a pre-script, layout the story structure, dialogue and visual opportunities that will make an audience care

  • Work with production team to spec visuals (b-roll and graphics) and to ensure scripts can be executed by the production team within the budget and timeline

4. Lead Interviews On Set

  • Conduct on-camera interviews

  • Charm patients and clinicians to help them be their best on camera

  • Gather content that closely matches the pre-script, plus extra unexpected goodies

5. Create the Narrative

  • Turn interviews into video scripts that match the creative brief, balancing emotional truth, clinical accuracy, and regulatory guidelines

  • Work with producers and post-production team to ensure content stays on brief through final delivery

  • Support the editorial process to completion with your subject matter expertise, keeping the client’s interests in mind.

You May Come From

· Healthcare or science journalism (patient or clinician storytelling)

· Medical communications, MedTech or pharma marketing, or clinical communications

· Healthcare-focused PR (especially within MedTech or pharma)

· Non-fiction or interview-driven storytelling (with exposure to complex subject matter)

Must-Haves

· Experience working in healthcare, medtech, pharma, or clinical environments

· Proven ability to learn complex topics fast and explain them succinctly

· Strong writing + storytelling ability

· Experience interviewing patients and clinicians Meticulous communication and thinking—able to operate in highly regulated environments where precision, accuracy, and professionalism are non-negotiable

· High attention to detail

· Willingness to travel

Bonus Points

· Experience navigating legal, medical or compliance guidelines in regulated content environments

Not a Fit If Your Experience is Limited to:

· Creating content for broad, B2C audiences rather than crafting stories for highly targeted, expert audiences with defined needs

· Scripted narrative content

· Reality TV

What Success Looks Like

· You can hold and navigate depth across multiple complex projects simultaneously—quickly getting up to speed, retaining critical details, and switching between projects without losing accuracy or context

· Concepts are strategically grounded and well-researched, using clinical evidence, audience insight, and thoughtful pre-interviews to support the client’s goals

· Content remains on brief throughout the project lifecycle, accurately reflecting the client’s messaging strategy and objectives from concept through final delivery

· Pre-interviews and interviews are conducted with professionalism and high emotional intelligence, resulting in authentic, engaging stories that align with both patient experience and client intent

· Scripts clearly and effectively deliver on messaging targets, integrating clinical accuracy and patient/clinician perspective while staying true to approved positioning and tone

· Patients and clinicians feel respected and supported, and clinician audiences find the content credible, relevant, and worth their time

Details

· We’ll train you in the Authentica Way, but you need strong instincts and experience coming in with the desire to get the job done using Authentica’s process.

· 40 hr/week contract → potential full-time

· Must work PST/MST hours

· Salary is $70,000—$100,000/year, DOE

your mission

At AVIAN, our mission is clear: we stop fires before they start. Our infrared camera systems and AI-driven monitoring help industrial companies detect abnormal heat early, prevent fire risk, protect assets, and avoid costly downtime.

We have reached product-market fit. We have the product, the proof, and strong customer demand. Now we need the marketing engine.

As Marketing Lead, your mission is to build an AI-forward marketing function that helps AVIAN scale to $10M+ ARR. This is not a traditional marketing role. We are not trying to hire a large team or manage a network of agencies. We want one exceptional operator using AI agents, automation, and sharp positioning to do the work of a small team.

You will own the 1-to-many growth engine: brand authority, demand generation, content, website conversion, lifecycle marketing, event amplification, and AI-driven outbound support.

You will:

  • Build AVIAN’s AI-forward marketing operating model from the ground up.
  • Own LinkedIn, founder-brand content, and high-signal thought leadership for industrial fire prevention, insurance, and manufacturing.
  • Use AI workflows to create programmatic content at scale across customer stories, vertical pages, SEO/AIO pages, outbound assets, and sales enablement.
  • Build AI-driven outbound research and enrichment workflows for priority accounts, sectors, and buying committees.
  • Design lifecycle automation beyond standard nurture, including lead scoring, reactivation, segmentation, trigger-based campaigns, and sales handoff.
  • Improve AVIAN’s website conversion, landing pages, SEO, and AI-search visibility.
  • Turn trade fairs into pipeline through pre-event targeting, content, booking flows, on-site support, and post-event follow-up.
  • Build and manage lean growth experiments across paid, organic, email, content, and partner channels.
  • Work closely with sales to convert marketing activity into qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Track what works, cut what does not, and build repeatable systems.
This is a hands-on IC role. You will write, build, automate, launch, analyze, and improve.

your profile

You are a mid-to-senior marketing operator who ships. You know how to build when there is no playbook, and you have already used AI to replace manual marketing work in production.

Must-haves:

  • Experience as a #1 or #2 marketing hire at a B2B startup, ideally in deep-tech, industrial SaaS, hardware-enabled SaaS, IoT, insurance-tech, or a related category.
  • Proven track record building pipeline in a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Evidence of agentic AI workflows in production, not just prompting or experimentation.
  • Ability to demo AI workflows you have shipped, such as outbound research agents, enrichment pipelines, programmatic content systems, lifecycle automation, custom GPTs, Claude projects, Clay workflows, Lindy agents, n8n automations, or similar.
  • Public evidence of an AI-native marketing point of view, such as writing, side projects, GitHub, Loom walkthroughs, shipped tools, or documented workflows.
  • Strong content ability across positioning, landing pages, LinkedIn, founder voice, email, and sales enablement.
  • Strong demand-generation instincts across inbound, outbound support, events, lifecycle, and conversion.
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and marketing automation systems.
  • Ability to operate without a large team, agency layer, or perfect process.
  • Strong analytical discipline and clear ROI thinking.
  • High ownership, direct communication, and bias for action.
  • Fluent English.
Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience marketing to manufacturers, plant managers, safety teams, maintenance leaders, insurers, brokers, or industrial operators.
  • Experience in industrial IoT, fire prevention, predictive maintenance, machine vision, automation, safety tech, or hardware-enabled SaaS.
  • Experience with SEO, AIO, programmatic landing pages, paid search, paid social, and conversion optimization.
  • Experience planning and executing trade fair marketing.
  • German language skills.
  • Based in Zurich, Europe, or a major US industrial hub.

why us?

AVIAN is building a new category in industrial fire prevention. Our product protects real facilities, real assets, and real people. The impact is immediate, measurable, and operationally critical.

You will join at the right stage: product-market fit is proven, customer demand is real, and the commercial organization is ready to scale. This is the opportunity to build a modern marketing function from scratch, with AI at the center rather than bolted on afterward.

What we offer:

  • Direct reporting line to the CEO.
  • Full ownership of AVIAN’s marketing engine.
  • Opportunity to build an AI-forward function that replaces the work of a small team.
  • Clear mandate to create pipeline, brand authority, and repeatable growth systems.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Performance-based variable compensation tied to pipeline and ARR milestones.
  • Equity participation.
  • Budget authority for tools, experiments, events, and selective external support.
  • Flexible, high-trust working model.
  • International team with a clear mission and strong customer focus.
  • Opportunity to help scale AVIAN to $10M+ ARR and beyond.
The AVIAN Way:
  • Clarity, ownership, speed. Everyone owns outcomes end-to-end.
  • Fail fast, fix faster. We learn quickly and improve continuously.
  • Radical transparency. Shared knowledge, open decisions, constant feedback.
  • Global and focused. International team, customer-obsessed, real-world impact.
AVIAN is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.
