​

Job Overview

TE Sensors delivers leading-edge Sensor solutions to solve clients’ most complex challenges and enable new possibilities that help them realize their innovation goals and vision. As one of the world’s largest sensor manufacturers, we offer a unique combination of co-creation capabilities, proven engineering expertise, strong product performance and reliability, and a deep understanding of client industries and challenges – all with a global footprint that enables us to respond with agility and collaborate more effectively.

We operate on a foundation of core values that include integrity, accountability, teamwork, and innovation. The Sensors Marketing team is a dynamic, collaborative, global marketing team comprised of professionals with diverse experience across all major marketing disciplines and multiple industries. At TE, you will join one of FORTUNE’S World’s Most Admired Companies and find lifelong learning, a diverse work environment, flexibility through remote work, opportunities to shape your career, and a winning team culture.

Job Overview

As a member of the Sensors Marketing team, the Product and Channel Marketing Analyst will help bring TE’s sensor technologies to market by leading new product launches and technology-focused campaigns, while supporting channel promotions across the Americas and EMEA.

The successful candidate will own go-to-market and promotional plans, coordinating execution across segment marketing teams, external agencies, and a cross-functional team including Sales, Product Management, and technical stakeholders. They will help ensure activities remain aligned, on schedule, within budget, and focused on measurable results.

The role will also partner with Distribution Sales teams and the Segment Channel Marketing team to support distributor promotions, product launches, training, content syndication, events and joint marketing initiatives.

In addition, this position may support application-focused campaigns and other integrated marketing programs as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute integrated go-to-market plans for new product launches and technology-focused campaigns across the Americas and EMEA.
  • Partner with Product Management to develop positioning, messaging, value propositions, competitive analysis, and promotional strategies.
  • Create and coordinate launch plans, training, presentations, battlecards, sell sheets, messaging documents, digital content, distributor toolkits, and sales enablement materials.
  • Lead cross-functional project meetings, establish timelines and responsibilities, manage dependencies, and hold stakeholders accountable for deliverables.
  • Coordinate campaign execution across Marketing, Sales, Product Management, Engineering, System Architects, Shared Services, agencies, and other partners.
  • Support channel marketing initiatives, including distributor promotions, content syndication, product education, campaign planning, and product stocking activities.
  • Coordinate lead follow-up with prequalification and regional sales teams, monitor lead progression, and address routing or follow-up issues.
  • Manage assigned marketing budgets and track spending against planned activities.
  • Report on launch and campaign performance and recommend opportunities for improvement.
  • Measure results using metrics such as on-time execution, MQLs, pipeline and opportunity value, campaign engagement, sales enablement adoption, distributor engagement, and revenue through distribution.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • 10% travel.

What your background should look like

Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent post-secondary qualification in Marketing, Business, Communications, Sales, or a related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of marketing experience, including demonstrated product, channel, distribution, or B2B marketing experience.
  • Experience developing and executing product launches, go-to-market plans, integrated campaigns, or channel marketing initiatives.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to independently coordinate multiple cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong writing, editing, presentation, and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to translate complex or technical information into clear and compelling marketing communications.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience measuring campaign performance and developing recommendations.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills with the ability to articulate business strategies and technical concepts both in written and verbal form.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Eloqua, Demandbase, and Adobe Analytics preferred.
  • Experience in the sensor industry is preferred. Experience in our strategic markets—including electronics, industrial technology, automotive, medical, and aerospace—is also considered an asset.
  • Ability to accommodate meetings across North American and European time zones.

Personal Competencies

    • Dynamic and positive energy
    • Strong ownership, initiative, and accountability.
    • Ability to influence stakeholders and lead through collaboration rather than direct authority.
    • Commercial and results-oriented mindset.
    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
    • Ability to manage shifting timelines and competing priorities.
    • Clear and confident communication skills.
    • Proactive approach to identifying risks and resolving issues.
    • Strong attention to detail, along with strong writing, editing, and presentation skills, are essential
    • Collaborative, adaptable, and committed to high-quality execution.
    • Interest in sensor technologies and technical products.
    • Native or expert English language skills required. Additional non-English language fluency is a plus.

Competencies

Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

COMPENSATION
• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $95,600 – 119,400 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
• Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.

BENEFITS
• A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com. Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Account Manager

About the job

Twilio is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager who is going to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers. As a designated TAM you will be supporting customers during Eastern hours (9am to 6pm Eastern) and working on the cases created by customers and resolving complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture. The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime. You are able to remain calm and effective at higher workloads as well as excelling at prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency. There will also be the potential need to volunteer for holiday coverage on a stipend basis.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
  • Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve complex problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
  • Collaborate with your teammates and the Twilio Product and Engineering teams via Slack as well as filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
  • Understanding customer trends, analyzing patterns, driving betterments and reporting what you observe to the management team in order to better improve our support process is a key part of the role.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 4 to 6+ years of relevant experience
  • Good knowledge of RESTful technology, previous work with APIs and ability to understand and troubleshoot issues with cloud solutions.
  • Broad capabilities to troubleshoot server-side code (Java, Node.js, PHP, C#, Python) and client-side JavaScript, with a good understanding of React and Redux
  • Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues, with an understanding of TCP/UDP, and basics of SSL/TLS.
  • High competency in communicating complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences via phone or email mediums
  • Comfortable in working with customers’ developers to troubleshoot use of the Twilio helper libraries.
  • Have an inquisitive mind to understand how things work
  • Advanced time management skills, ability to work well under pressure, and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
  • Excellence in task prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency.
  • Interest in utilizing customer feedback to identify and drive improvements in our products.
  • Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.
  • Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
  • Experience in managing dedicated customer accounts.

Desired:

  • Understanding of Telecoms and VOIP including WebRTC and SIP

Location

This role will be remote and based in Colombia, providing support during 9am to 6pm Eastern Time

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Are you looking for limitless career opportunities with a company that values growth, innovation, and teamwork? Our clients view us as an essential part of their teams, relying on us for strategic guidance, fast solutions to complex challenges, and proactive support. With strategic locations across the U.S. and leadership from our founder, Steven Freidkin, we’re on the front lines of a fast-paced industry, facing cybersecurity threats and rapid technology changes together.

If you thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment and enjoy going above and beyond, we’d love to meet you. Come explore one of our many opportunities and grow with us!

How you’ll make an impact

The Accounts Payable Credit Card Specialist will assist in ensuring that the company processes credit card payable invoices accurately and in a timely manner.

Location and Work Expectations

  • This is a remote position; however, team members should be willing and able to travel if the need arises, though such travel is expected to be infrequent. Candidates with proximity to one of our Centers of Excellence are preferred (Lombard, IL; McLean, VA; Shreveport, LA; Overland Park, KS).

What you will be doing

  • Review & Process company credit card transactions in our payable system in compliance with financial policies and procedures.
  • Perform daily financial transactions, including verifying, classifying, computing, posting and recording credit card accounts payable data.
  • Review credit card accounts for potential duplication of services, areas where we can consolidate charges for potential savings.
  • Submit credit card payments for approval prior to due date with Controller and CFO.
  • Once payment is approved, generate payment to American Express.
  • Reconcile the credit card accounts payable ledger to ensure that all payables are accounted for and properly posted. The subledger must reconcile with the General Ledger accounts at the end of each month.
  • Review approved expense reimbursements bi-monthly to ensure they comply with company policies.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have

Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit www.eastman.com.

Role Profile

The Product & Pricing Center of Excellence is a key part of Eastman’s updated business operating model which, along with COEs in Marketing and Sales, have a mandate to build and elevate Eastman’s enterprise-wide commercial capability.

Sitting within the Strategy & Commercial Excellence group- the Product and Pricing COE is charged with driving enterprise-wide commercial excellence by standardizing product management and pricing practices, harmonizing key processes and metrics, partnering with businesses on high-value initiatives, and leading technology-enabled improvements with Eastman Digital Services. The COE also builds product and pricing talent through learning and development tools, methods, and competency-based capability building to strengthen performance, consistency, and long-term organizational capability.

Location: This role is open to remote work.

Responsibilities

Pricing Processes

  • Collaborate with the Product and Pricing COE LT to influence and support the sustained adoption of standard pricing processes, tools, and methodologies across business units.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource to advise teams on strategic pricing process and execution with enterprise standards.
  • Help identify process gaps, recommend improvements, and reinforce consistent ways of working across the organization.

Analysis & Commercial Effectiveness

  • Lead analysis and reporting of pricing effectiveness, including performance trends, process adoption and business impact.
  • Monitor key initiatives, track progress against milestones, and support follow-through on actions and adjustments.
  • Identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities that can strengthen pricing practices and commercial execution.

Capability Building & Enablement

  • Oversee role-based onboarding and learning programs for product and pricing roles, delivered through a blended learning model of e-learning, virtual workshops, office hours, and facilitator-led courses. Periodically refreshing training materials as needed.
  • Support enterprise product and pricing capability assessments, as well as candidate interviews for pricing roles

Process Improvement and Change Enablement

  • Collaborate with Product and Pricing COE LT by supporting projects/initiatives focused on improving processes, pricing discipline, pricing governance, and commercial execution.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements, translating business requirements into actionable system enhancements collaborating closely with functional and IT partners
  • Support transformation initiatives by helping define change impacts, communication needs, and drive post-launch adoption of new processes, tools, and behaviors.
  • Network internally and externally to share best practices and research potential solutions to improve product and pricing capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Progressive experience in B2B commercial, pricing, product management, commercial analytics, or revenue management roles, typically 8+ years.
  • Proven experience embedding standardized pricing processes across business units.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders through data-driven insights and practical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex commercial data into actionable business guidance.
  • Hands-on experience using or supporting pricing platforms such as Pricefx, Vendavo, SAP, or similar tools.
  • Proven ability to work independently, collaborate effectively across functions, and contribute to a complex matrixed organization.

The base salary range for this position is $104,000 to $143,000. ​

At Eastman, we are committed to transparency and integrity in our compensation practices. Eastman includes salary ranges in some job postings to provide clear compensation information and to be compliant with state laws that require disclosure. Not all postings display ranges due to factors like location, market conditions, or position specifics. Compensation is based on qualifications and experience. Candidates are encouraged to discuss their salary questions during the interview process.

Benefits

Your total rewards go far beyond a competitive salary. When you join Eastman, you gain access to an exceptional suite of programs designed to protect your health, grow your wealth, and fuel your career.

Compensation & Incentives
• Base pay plus performance-based incentive opportunities that let you share in our success.

Health & Wellness
• Comprehensive medical, prescription-drug, and dental coverage—paired with a Health Savings Account option to help you save tax-free dollars for care today or in the future.
• A robust menu of voluntary benefits—including vision, optional life, critical-illness protection, and more—so you can tailor coverage to fit your life.
• Holistic wellness support: financial-planning tools, family-building assistance (adoption, pregnancy, and fertility resources), parental leave, and confidential Employee Assistance Program counseling.

Retirement & Financial Strategies
• 401(k) with a company match—plus an additional annual retirement contribution from Eastman to accelerate your long-term savings.

Time Away
• Eleven paid holidays, one personal day, paid time off, and paid vacation to recharge, celebrate, or handle life’s moments.

Growth & Development
• Access to mentorship, learning resources, and leadership programs that empower you to thrive in your current role and chart the next steps in your career.

At Eastman, we invest in the whole you—so you can bring your best self to work every day and build a future you’re proud of.

Eastman Chemical Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, pregnancy, veteran status or any other protected classes as designated by law.

Eastman is committed to creating a powerfully engaged workplace, where everyone can contribute to their fullest potential each day.

About the Role

Nimble Gravity is looking for an experienced Scrum Master – AI Delivery to help drive predictable, high-quality delivery across complex AI and technology initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering, Data, and AI teams to ensure priorities and sprint goals are clear and realistic.

  • Own delivery planning, milestone tracking, dependencies, risks, issues, and overall project coordination.

  • Identify and remove blockers across teams, including technical dependencies, data access, integrations, security reviews, and shared services.

  • Track delivery metrics such as velocity, throughput, cycle time, and unplanned work to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.

  • Coordinate work across multiple teams, stakeholders, and external partners when needed.

  • Provide clear visibility into project status, risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines.

  • Communicate progress and potential issues clearly to both technical teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Coach teams on Agile best practices while encouraging accountability, ownership, and effective collaboration.

  • Support project governance and executive-level reporting across AI initiatives.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in Scrum Master, Agile Delivery, Project Management, or similar roles.

  • Experience working with technical, data, AI, or software engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and Scrum practices.

  • Solid project management skills, including planning, risk management, dependency management, and stakeholder communication.

  • Experience managing multiple projects, teams, or workstreams simultaneously.

  • Strong facilitation, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

You bring structure without slowing teams down. You anticipate risks before they become blockers, keep stakeholders aligned, and help technical teams deliver consistently.

raw.title: Senior Specialist, Regulatory & PV Network
raw.excerpt: The Senior Specialist, Regulatory and PV Network is responsible for developing the strategy based on regulatory requirements and for driving regulatory and PV deliverables based on an established PV and regulatory plan.
raw.description:
The Senior Specialist, Regulatory and PV Network is responsible for developing the strategy based on regulatory requirements and for driving regulatory and PV deliverables based on an established PV and regulatory plan. They also serve as a liaison between regulatory and other functional areas including external partners, clients, authorities and/or consultants in the planning, organizing, and preparing of regulatory deliverables following project, corporate and industry regulatory strategies.

The Senior Specialist will also act as Local Contact Person for Pharmacovigilance for the designated country.

Job Responsibilities

  • Act as Local Contact Person for Pharmacovigilance for the designated country
  • Assume leadership and functional representation for projects of medium/high complexity ensuring effective and rapid coordination and management of regulatory deliverables, driving the team to meet the agreed targets and to comply with the agreed procedures, trackers and templates
  • With the help of a senior member of the team, develop strategy and manage set up activities (Project Management Plan, joint operating procedures, POAs and core documents)
  • Provide strategic input to internal and external customers and promptly identify and address any risk/potential risk by implementing preventive measures
  • Problem solve and support achievement of satisfactory resolution of performance issues or delivery failures
  • Collect, review, track and maintain LCPs' CVs, job descriptions, training records, contact details and monthly reports
  • Ensure correct training assignment to and training compliance by the LCPs
  • Ensure all team members assigned to the project for departmental deliverables are aware of the tasks and time allocated, monitor project budgets, hours spent vs budgeted and promptly identify and escalate any OoS
  • Provide support to proposal development and input to budgets, provide department representation to BD meetings as required
  • Prepare client’s invoices and review/approve vendors’ project invoices
  • Provide training, coaching and mentoring to junior members of staff
  • Foster professional working relationships with internal and external contacts at the local and international levels to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery
  • Stay abreast of changing regulatory legislative requirements and ensure maintenance of the regulatory intelligence database and timely dissemination of pertinent changes
  • Participate in and/or support junior members in preparation for audits/inspections and provide department representation for assigned projects as required
  • Track LCPs' key performance indicators and prepare monthly summary reports
  • Provide feedback on performance of vendors to aid their assessment
  • Provide input to department / company initiatives and contribute to the design/review of SOPs/working practice/guidance.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry or Life Sciences, Nursing, or equivalent experience
  • Strong experience within pharmaceutical or CRO industry or Regulatory body
  • Good knowledge of ICH GCP and/or GVP and national regulations for territories of competency
  • PV training and/or working experience and other educational or professional background as required locally
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal
  • Candidate must be proficient in the official language of the country in which they are based, as this is essential for local interactions and compliance
  • Good planning and organizational skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills in a fast-paced, deadline oriented, and changing environment
  • Good attention to detail

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

raw.description:
characteristics

  • Fixed-term employment contract (initially for two years)
  • Full-time
  • Fully remote from Germany or abroad (German working hours) or hybrid from Hanover, Munich or Leipzig
  • Published on 21.08.2026
  • Application deadline: 31.12.2026
  • Earliest start date: 01.08.2027
  • Teaching load of 18 SWS

about us

velpTEC is an education institute focused on innovative technologies, combining experience from business, future studies, and new educational approaches. Through our educational offerings, we support people in strengthening their skills for the future in a practice-oriented way, helping them actively shape their own paths in life – and from 2027 onward, also in higher education.
VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) is a private university of applied sciences currently undergoing the process of state recognition through the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture. Our degree programs are launching in the fields of digital technologies, engineering, and innovation-driven management – with a clear commitment to continuously expanding our portfolio and responding to new developments. We understand teaching as a space for shaping solutions for tomorrow. Our approach is project-based, competency-oriented, and closely interlinked with practice. We are looking for individuals who are eager to break new ground in higher education and want to actively help shape our innovative learning environment.
We are filling a W2-Professorship in Design Foundations and Visual Communication (100 %).

your responsibilities

  • Program development: Contributing to the development of the Bachelor's program in Future Design and Immersive Systems, and assisting in recruiting students
  • Masterclasses and expert seminars: Conducting live sessions on design fundamentals, visual communication, branding and human-centered design in English
  • Student supervision and examination formats: Providing academic guidance, mentoring, and support for project and research work; designing and evaluating portfolio assessments, exams, and bachelor's theses
  • Applied research: Conducting practice-oriented research and transfer projects in the areas of visual communication, design methodology, and human-centered design – in cooperation with industry and research institutions
  • Funding and cooperation: Initiating research collaborations and acquiring third-party funding to strengthen applied research at our university
  • Publications and presentations: Publishing research findings in academic journals and at relevant conferences, as well as representing the university at specialist presentations and industry events
  • Transfer: Willingness to participate in research-related product developments, founding/start-up ventures, and patent applications
  • University development: Contributing to the university's academic self-governance, helping to further develop the range of study programs, and participating in international collaboration

recruitment and qualification requirements

The recruitment requirements for professors are governed by § 25 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act (NHG):
  • A completed university degree
  • Pedagogical-didactic aptitude confirmed through practical experience
  • Special aptitude for in-depth independent scholarly work, generally evidenced by an above-average doctorate in the fields of design, visual communication, design research or related fields
  • Special achievements in the application or development of scientific findings and methods over at least five years of professional practice, of which at least three years must have been carried out outside the higher education sector – preferably in design, visual communication, branding, or creative direction roles in industry

in addition, we assume

  • The ability and willingness to conduct teaching, research, and transfer activities in English.
  • Willingness to develop and further build higher education teaching competencies – particularly in (generative) AI-supported teaching.

in addition, we value

  • Innovative spirit in teaching: Motivation to develop and apply new didactic formats in design fundamentals and visual communication education
  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design
  • Practice and transfer orientation: Proven experience in industry or research projects related to design and visual communication
  • International perspective: Experience in international contexts or motivation to integrate international design and communication perspectives into teaching and research.
  • Commitment to institutional development: Willingness to actively shape the foundation and growth of a new university
  • Research profile: A visible research focus in visual communication, design methodology, or human-centered design
  • Knowledge and technology transfer: Understanding research as a bridge between science, industry, and society

what we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.
  • A professorship with a clear focus on teaching, quality assurance, and applied research.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration with colleagues in applied computing and AI, digital business transformation, and immersive design.
  • Modern digital infrastructure and an innovative environment without outdated structures.
  • Collaboration with the Center for Higher Education Teaching (Kompetenzzentrum Lehre) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg on the development of higher education teaching competencies.
  • Fully remote from Germany or abroad (German working hours) or hybrid from Hanover, Munich or Leipzig
  • Flexible working hours with core working hours – medical appointments, childcare, and other important commitments are no problem
  • Fixed salary + performance-based bonus + €100 per month (for full-time employees) towards a company pension plan after 6 months + 15% employer contribution to your own payments + attractive employee discounts
  • 1 additional day of paid leave per year for volunteering
  • Annual health budget of €600 (for full-time employees) after 6 months + access to more than 13,000 fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass
  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation

application documents and further information

  • Please submit your application, together with the required documents, in English via our online portal. You can access the online portal through the "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" button. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by post or email.
  • The following application documents are expected; mandatory documents are marked with *:
    • *Cover letter
    • *CV (including an overview of previous employment since your first university degree, providing information on subject-related and application-oriented professional experience relevant to the advertised professorship; supporting documents such as employment references are welcome)
    • *Final certificate from the last general education school attended
    • *Certificates and/or diplomas for academic degrees (e.g., diploma, bachelor's, master's, doctorate)
    • *List of teaching activities
    • *Evidence of pedagogical-didactic aptitude (e.g., certificates for higher education teaching training, evaluation results of courses taught, teaching-related awards or scholarships)
    • *List of research activities
    • *List of publications and, where applicable, presentations
    • If applicable, list of third-party funding acquisitions
    • If applicable, list of international experience and cooperations
  • Application documents must be submitted as scans. Please use the upload fields provided in the online portal. For your cover letter, use the "Anschreiben" upload; for your CV, use the "Lebenslauf" upload; and for your employment references, use the "Arbeitszeugnis" upload. For all other documents, please use the "Andere" upload.
  • The recognition of foreign educational qualifications requires proof of equivalence. Initial points of contact can be found via the portal www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de or
  • Equal opportunity and diversity are actively promoted and practiced at VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung). This position is explicitly open to people of all genders (m/f/d). Applications from female scientists are expressly welcomed.
  • Application costs will not be reimbursed.
In the further course of the appointment procedure, candidates may be asked, upon request, to give a teaching session, outline a research project, and complete at least one interview.
By submitting your application documents, you consent to them being forwarded to the Appointment Committee. Within the appointment procedure, certain persons/committee members have the right to inspect the documents. These include members of the Presidential Board, the Senate, the University Council, and the Appointment Committee, as well as the sponsoring institution (velpTEC GmbH). Furthermore, the Officer for Equality and Diversity, where applicable the Officer for (Severe) Disability, and the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture have the right to inspect the application documents. Application documents submitted to VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) are handled in accordance with data protection requirements and are used and stored exclusively for the purposes of the appointment procedure. They will not be passed on to third parties. Upon conclusion of the appointment procedure, the application documents will be destroyed in compliance with the relevant data protection requirements. For any data protection questions, the data protection officers of velpTEC GmbH () are happy to assist you.

your contacts

For questions regarding employment law, the appointment procedure, or the recruitment requirements, please contact Mr. Kay-Uwe Klaus; for content-related questions about the job posting, please contact Dr. Mattis Hartwig at .

• Als Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Vertriebsinnendienst berätst Du unsere Bestands‑ und Neukunden zu Analyseleistungen, Probenahmen und technischen Anforderungen.
  • Du erstellst individuelle Angebote, prüfst deren Vollständigkeit und stimmst Dich hierzu eng mit dem Account Management ab.
  • Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört außerdem die Ausarbeitung technischer Lösungskonzepte auf Basis von Kundenanforderungen und unserem Leistungsportfolio.
  • Du klärst Prüfparameter, Methoden und Prüfanforderungen in Zusammenarbeit mit Laborleitung und Prüfleitung und stellst einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss sicher.
  • Darüber hinaus dokumentierst Du Vertriebsaktivitäten im CRM‑System, koordinierst Kundentermine und bearbeitest eingehende Anfragen.
  • In deiner Rolle unterstützt Du die enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen, insbesondere mit dem Labor, wodurch Du maßgeblich zu einem effizienten Ablauf beiträgst.
  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder naturwissenschaftliche Ausbildung und bringst bereits Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst mit.
  • Erste Kenntnisse in der Angebotskalkulation konntest Du bereits sammeln und Du weißt, wie man Prioritäten richtig setzt.
  • Auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst Du den Überblick und arbeitest strukturiert sowie zuverlässig.
  • Du überzeugst durch Empathie, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung.
  • Der Umgang mit gängigen IT-Systemen fällt Dir leicht und Du hast Spaß an digitalen Prozessen.
  • Als Teamplayer bringst Du Dich aktiv ein, unterstützt Deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen und arbeitest lösungsorientiert mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen zusammen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Freue Dich auf

  • die Chance auf eine langfristige und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem globalen Unternehmen, wo kein Tag ist wie der andere.
  • eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen sowie ein Team, in dem Kollegialität großgeschrieben wird.
  • eine intensive und individuell auf Dich zugeschnittene Einarbeitung.
  • regelmäßige Evaluationsgespräche, um Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung gezielt zu fördern.
  • attraktive Vorzüge wie JobRad, Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge exklusiv für Eurofins-Mitarbeiter.
  • regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.

Unternehmensbeschreibung

Die Kreativität unserer Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) bringt das Unternehmen voran. Wir suchen Persönlichkeiten, die die Zukunft mitgestalten und etwas bewegen. Kunden­orientierung aus Überzeugung und ein verantwortungsbewusster Umgang mit natürlichen Ressourcen bringen uns dabei unserem Ziel täglich näher, weltweiter Marktführer in allen Segmenten zu sein.

In nur 35 Jahren ist Eurofins von einem Labor in Nantes, Frankreich, auf ca. 65.000 Mitarbeitende in einem Netzwerk von mehr als 950 unabhängigen Unternehmen in 59 Ländern mit mehr als 950 Laboratorien gewachsen. Eurofins bietet ein Portfolio von mehr als 200.000 Analysemethoden zur Bewertung der Sicherheit, Identität, Zusammensetzung, Authentizität, Herkunft, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Reinheit von biologischen Substanzen und Produkten sowie innovative Dienstleistungen im Bereich der klinischen Diagnostik als einer der weltweit führenden, aufstrebenden Anbieter von spezialisierten klinischen Diagnosetests.

Im Jahr 2025 erzielte Eurofins einen Gesamtumsatz von 7,296 Milliarden Euro und zählt in den letzten 20 Jahren zu einer der Aktien mit der besten Wertentwicklung in Europa.

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO)

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact.

Role Overview

ServiceNow’s Security Incident Command (SIC) team is seeking an experienced senior security incident commander to join our fast-growing team. This role will support the orchestration of incident response strategy and communications during critical information security-related incidents.

About the SIC team

The SIC team maintains and executes the Major Security Incidents (MSI) lifecycle within ServiceNow, including Preparation, Response, and Recovery. MSIs are our most challenging and impactful security incidents which pose active or heightened risk to the company and/or our customers.

Key value areas are preparing the company for MSIs through tabletop exercises (TTX), coordination of activity between many response workstream partners, maintenance and development of playbooks and procedures, tracking key MSI metrics and facts to keep everyone oriented, and communicating status, milestones, blockers, and critical decisions needed to senior management and executive stakeholders, including the CISO.

What you get to do in this role

  • Orchestration of response and remediation of incident response for highest criticality security events. 
  • Take ownership and lead response to critical incidents within the company.
  • Establish and mature documentation surrounding protocols and procedures governing the security incident command team.
  • Prepare and deliver communications, including executive summaries and incident briefings, to key stakeholders during and after incident response. 
  • Conduct rapid response, mitigation, and investigations on the highest priority cases impacting ServiceNow and user data. 
  • Partner with the team members across multiple regions to drive response and investigations globally. 
  • Organization and facilitation of scenario-based exercises to test and improve incident management and response strategies.
  • Maintenance of existing playbooks and procedures, as well as developing new ones, to further standardize SIC and its partners' responses when verifying MSIs.
  • Contribute to the organization and completion of Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) following major security incidents.
  • Identify new ways to simplify, integrate, automate and refine the major security incident process to better support internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications 

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 8+ years of total cybersecurity professional experience, or similar experience with education
  • 4–6+ years of deep domain expertise in incident response and/or incident management
  • Experience leading or supporting complex security incidents to resolution end-to-end. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English)
  • Comfort communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences (highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Ability to quickly and accurately assess a situation, identify and prioritize risks, and make sound decision
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles and frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK). 
  • Knowledge across multiple security domains is a plus. 
  • Experience planning and/or orchestrating tabletop exercises is a plus.

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

raw.title: Head of Revenue Operations
raw.excerpt: About usTruffle Security is a cybersecurity company on a mission to make secrets easier to detect, verify, and remediate across modern software environments.
raw.description:
About us

Truffle Security is a cybersecurity company on a mission to make secrets easier to detect, verify, and remediate across modern software environments. Built on the popular open-source TruffleHog™ secrets scanning platform, the company's enterprise solution gives security and engineering teams everything they need to find exposed credentials, understand which ones are active, and act on them with confidence.

With support for 800+ credential types, Truffle Security continuously monitors non-human identities (NHIs) and their associated secrets across code repositories, SaaS applications, wikis, and cloud systems. It goes beyond detection by verifying which secrets are live, analyzing their scope of access, and streamlining remediation through automated workflows and lifecycle management so teams can prioritize what to revoke and confirm it's done without manual follow-up.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, Chick-fil-A, and OpenAI, Truffle Security helps security and engineering teams stay ahead of secrets risk.

About the role

This is our first dedicated Revenue Operations leadership hire, and we're going to be honest about what you're walking into.

Our GTM systems and processes work, but they were built reactively as the business grew. There is not yet a cohesive, intentional revenue operations architecture, and that's exactly what we're hiring you to create.

That's the opportunity. You'll own the full GTM operations stack, define what RevOps means at Truffle, and build the function from a strong revenue base rather than a blank page. You'll inherit one Business Systems team member, hire a planned GTM Engineer, and grow the team as the business scales, including standing up functions like deal desk that don't exist today.

We're open on level. Depending on your experience, this role could be Director or VP scope. What matters is that you've built before and want to build again.

What you'll be working on

  • Systems foundation. Your first-year priority. Assess our Salesforce instance and strengthen it into a coherent architecture with clean data, clear definitions, and reporting people actually trust, then bring the surrounding GTM stack into alignment with it.
  • Full GTM operations. Sales ops, marketing ops, and CS ops under one roof. You'll be the connective tissue across the entire revenue funnel, from lead attribution through renewal.
  • Revenue data integrity. One architecture across the stack where records move without corruption, business definitions are enforced in-system, and any number pulled by marketing, sales, finance, or the board reconciles with every other system. When a number is questioned, you are the answer.
  • Deal desk and quoting. Build the function from scratch and own it directly: pricing approvals, quote-to-close workflow, non-standard deal governance, and the guardrails that let AEs move fast without breaking things. At our size this is a process you run, not a team you inherit, with the option to staff it as deal volume grows.
  • Marketing operations infrastructure. Marketing leadership defines the strategy, the programs, and what qualifies as a lead. You own the machinery underneath: the infrastructure that captures, enriches, routes, and nurtures every lead marketing generates, and the measurement layer that ties program spend to pipeline.
  • Compensation design. Own comp plan design and modeling across sales and SDR functions. You'll partner with Finance, who owns administration and payout.
  • Forecasting. Own forecast methodology, cadence, and tooling. Build a forecast that sales leadership and the board trust, and run the operating rhythm behind it.
  • Annual planning. Territory design, capacity planning, and quota setting in partnership with sales leadership and Finance.
  • The GTM tech stack. Full ownership: vendor selection, contracts, budget, and consolidation. If a tool isn't earning its keep, you have the authority to kill it.
  • Process and definitions. Codify the rules of engagement: lead routing, sourcing attribution, opportunity stages, SQL definitions, forecast methodology. Turn tribal knowledge into a documented, enforced process.
  • Team building. Manage and develop our current Business Systems team member, with a GTM Engineer hire planned for this team to build automation and AI-driven workflows across the stack. You'll shape that role, make the hire, and grow the function from there.

What success looks like in year one

  • Salesforce runs on an intentional data model. There is one source of truth: marketing, sales, and finance pull the same numbers and get the same answers
  • Deal desk exists, with documented approval workflows and pricing guardrails in active use.
  • Lead routing, sourcing credit, and qualification definitions are codified and enforced in-system.
  • A forecast methodology is in place and holding up against actuals, with a weekly operating cadence around it.
  • Comp plans are designed, modeled, and documented, with a clean handoff to Finance for administration.
  • Sales leadership spends its time selling and coaching, not reconciling spreadsheets.

Our fiscal year starts February 1, so annual planning is an early deliverable, not a year-end one.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or GTM operations at B2B SaaS companies, with at least 2 years leading the function or a significant piece of it
  • Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise. You've taken an inherited instance and meaningfully improved its architecture, data quality, and reporting, not just administered it
  • You've owned the full architecture across a marketing automation platform and a CRM at a company that scaled, and made the two behave as one system. Our stack: Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, Common Room, Nooks, Gong
  • Experience standing up net-new functions (deal desk, marketing ops, CS ops) rather than inheriting mature ones
  • Comp plan design and modeling experience across AE and SDR roles
  • Experience owning forecast methodology and annual planning (territories, capacity, quotas) at a growing sales org
  • Strong analytical chops. You're fluent in pipeline math, conversion analysis, and forecast methodology, and you can defend your numbers to a CEO and a board
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity at an early-stage company. You'll set the strategy and do the work, especially early

Bonus points!

  • Experience in security, developer tools, or open source-driven companies
  • Experience turning open-source adoption signals into an enterprise revenue process. Our funnel starts with hundreds of thousands of daily open source users.
  • Experience supporting channel and partner sales models
  • Exposure to usage-based or seat-based pricing model transitions

Why this role

Most RevOps leaders inherit either a mess with no revenue or a mature machine with no room to build. This is neither. Truffle has real enterprise revenue, marquee logos, a healthy pipeline, and an executive team that knows the operations foundation needs investment and is hiring you to lead it. You'll have a mandate, a seat at the table, and a genuinely interesting business to operate.

Compensation

Salary Range:The target base salary range for this position is between $210,000 to $250,000 for candidates in the United States. Starting salary will vary based on job-related skills, knowledge, and experience. Leveling will be determined during the interview process. You may also be offered a bonus, stock options, and benefits. These salary ranges are subject to change, and we encourage candidates outside of this salary range to apply.

How we support our team

  • Fully remote within the U.S. – We believe opportunity shouldn’t be limited by geography. Our remote-first approach lets us hire the best people across the United States and empowers them to do their best work from wherever they are.
  • A culture of mentorship, equity, and psychological safety – We’re committed to fostering an environment where you can thrive, learn, and feel valued.
  • Competitive salary & meaningful equity – Be rewarded for your contributions with a strong compensation package and a stake in our shared success.
  • Flexible paid time off – We operate with a high level of autonomy and trust, giving you the flexibility to take time off as needed—no strict limits, just the expectation that you’re meeting your commitments and getting your work done.
  • 14 paid holidays – Including Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and "Truffle Holidays" when the entire company takes a well-deserved day off together.
  • Comprehensive health benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 80% of premiums covered for you and your dependents.
  • Remote work stipend – Get set up for success with an $800 new hire stipend and $100/month to keep your workspace comfortable.
  • Health & wellness stipend – $1,200/year to support your physical, mental, and emotional well-being— we believe that feeling good helps you do great work.
  • Learning & development stipend – $2,000/year to invest in your growth, whether it’s courses, certifications, or industry conferences.
  • 401(k) match – We match 100% of the first 6% of your contributions on every paycheck, helping you build financial security for the future.
  • 100% remote + company off-sites – Twice a year, we come together in amazing locations like Hawaii, Cabo, and the Rocky Mountains to collaborate and connect.

We’re looking for folks who are interested in being part of the journey to make the internet more secure. The internet is for all, and we believe that diverse experiences and people from all walks of life can contribute to this mission. That said, if what we’re doing resonates with your values, we’d love to have you apply even if you don’t check all of the boxes or match the job description to a tee.

Truffle strives to promote an equitable, inclusive, and psychologically-safe workplace for all who are interested in working with us. All job applicants will be considered throughout the employment process without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception/identity, age, pregnancy or parental status, disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. If you are an individual with disabilities and reasonable accommodation is needed throughout the interview process, or to perform essential job functions, please let your recruiter know.

Lastly, we ask that all applicants consider the opportunity to answer a few voluntary demographic questions on the job application. This helps us track the inclusivity of our recruiting initiatives. Answering these questions is entirely optional and your answers will not be shared with the hiring team and will not impact the hiring decision.

Note: Our organization participates in the US federal E-Verify program. We will provide the Social Security Administration, and if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. We do not use this information to pre-screen job applicants.

  • Comfortable working toward measurable accuracy, productivity, and turnaround targets

  • Ability to work full-time EST hours

Nice to Have:

Clinical Application Specialist (CAS) is a clinical education role focused on internal and external clinical and educational support. This role also supports broader company revenue growth goals via customer support and education. The CAS position will be responsible for providing training and education to new and existing Sentec users and will work closely with the field sales and marketing organization to support new hire and ongoing sales training and development. Expectations of the role include on-site and virtual education, training and CE and non-CE Presentations, and in-person state and potential national society presentations.

Key Tasks

  • Acts as the subject matter expert for the use of our products in our key market segments to support company revenue growth goals.
  • Collaborates with the local sales team to coordinate and deliver comprehensive onsite and virtual customer training and education i.e., curriculum, process/tools and programs.
  • Develops a common understanding of the technology across care providers and articulates the clinical & economic value proposition.
  • Participates in product evaluations and installations.
  • Assesses needs and ensures comprehensive education and hands-on training on our products, including maintenance and troubleshooting that addresses all members of the clinical team.
  • Provides education and training necessary to drive optimal bedside use of the technology in new and existing accounts.
  • This is a remote position (home-based in the greater New York area) with the ability to travel overnight (60%) and work flexible hours.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Science or equivalent education and/or experience.
  • Current RRT license is required.
  • Prior experience training/educating healthcare professionals is preferred.
  • Prior experience in the Medical Device Industry in a Clinical Specialist role is highly preferred.
  • Existing In-depth knowledge and usage of Sentec products preferred.
  • Ability to quickly understand new product enhancements and training programs/materials.
  • Must be vaccinated for Covid-19 and must obtain any/all required vaccinations as appropriate for vendor credentialing

Benefits

  • Meaningful work in a rapidly growing company with opportunity for advancement
  • Directly influence the quality of products and make a difference for patients worldwide
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth
  • The salary range for this position is $135,000–$150,000 commensurate with experience and credentials

Sentec offers competitive benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, and 401K matching, as well as paid parental leave, a wellness stipend and tuition reimbursement. Sentec emphasizes employee voices and recognizes hard work making it a promising environment for professional growth. Sentec focuses on delivering impactful healthcare products and improving patient care.

By choosing a career at Sentec, you’re not just choosing a job – you’re embracing the chance to make a real impact, contributing to the development of innovative medical solutions that support the wellbeing of individuals worldwide.

Sentec is a Swiss-American medical device company specializing in respiratory care. Since its founding in 1999, Sentec utilizes a deep-tech approach that is founded on advanced science and avant-garde technologies for respiratory patients across care areas. Sentec provides healthcare professionals worldwide with non-invasive, continuous monitoring and effective therapeutic solutions.

With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

Decision Analytics associates produce insights that answer key enterprise questions around budget, priorities, courses of action, and important decisions. They develop frameworks for analysis by identifying the right metrics for consistent, effective insights that drive business outcomes. Decision Analytics associates are skilled in advanced analytics and analytical tools and languages such as GCP Big Query, Python, R, SQL, Jupyter Notebook, Adobe Analytics, and Tableau. While they may have the ability to support model development and AI/ML work, they are primarily focused on internal business insights (i.e., business intelligence). Decision Analytics associates possess the domain expertise to understand the businesses they support with their analysis.

Senior Decision Analysts assist in the development of advanced analytics to support the company's strategic objectives. The role works cross-functionally with business partners from Merchandising, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Online and IT to design and implement decision analytics, tools, and new visibility/reporting capabilities. This role has responsibility for creating analytics, translating business questions to actionable insights, supporting ongoing analytical needs, designing new analytical tools, and collaborating with cross- functional teams to deliver high quality analytical solutions for The Home Depot. The Senior Decision Analyst monitors transformation of data and works with appropriate technology teams to resolve issues relating to incorrect mapping, business rules, and data deviations. Rockstaris hiring a full-timeBookkeeping, HR Virtual Assistanton behalf of a multi-location physical therapy practice.

The VA will keep QuickBooks records accurate and current, manage employee onboarding and payroll administration, and, once financial and HR responsibilities are up to date, help support patient-facing administrative needs like phones and scheduling.

This role is a great fit for someone who is comfortable moving between structured financial/HR work and warmer, more people-facing patient support, and who can prioritize accordingly depending on what needs attention each week.

Our client's mission is to help people Move Well, Be Strong, and Live Fully. They are committed to providing personalized, high-quality care across three Baltimore-area locations, serving patients aged 12 and up with both traditional and niche physical therapy services for orthopedic and spine conditions.

Their values, Grit, Shoshin (Beginner's Mind), Candor, Ownership, Engagement, and Enjoy the Journey, guide how they show up for their patients and for each other.

HR & Payroll Administration

Patient & Practice Support
When financial and HR responsibilities are current, remaining scheduled hours may be used to support patient-facing administrative needs, including:

  • Assist the patient care coordination team with routine administrative tasks
​

Requirements

  • Comfortable managing multiple areas of responsibility and shifting priorities week to week

raw.description:
Make Richpanel the company every CX leader knows before they need us.

Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk. We replace the old helpdesk and the next few support hires.

We are profitable, backed by Sequoia Capital, and trusted by 3,000+ paying brands. ARR is already in eight figures and growing 110% year over year. Our team is small by design.

DTC gave us our first market. Your job is to make it one of several.

You will own how Richpanel is understood, discovered, discussed, and chosen.

This role combines brand marketing, product marketing, channel building, and new-market development. It reports directly to the CEO.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Build a brand people remember

  • Make Richpanel's point of view clear across our site, decks, events, and customer stories.
  • Build an excellent X presence inside DTC, ecommerce, CX, and AI communities.
  • Turn customer evidence into posts, case studies, research, and conversations worth sharing.

Find the story that wins

  • Join sales calls and interview customers, lost deals, partners, and operators.
  • Test positioning and offers against real buyers.
  • Build battlecards that help sales win against Gorgias, Zendesk, Fin, Decagon, and Sierra.
  • Keep our website and pitch aligned with what buyers believe.

Diversify our channels

  • Make PPC, AEO, content, events, referrals, and partnerships produce qualified pipeline.
  • Set a clear thesis, budget, and success bar for every channel.

• Scale winners. Stop weak bets quickly.

Open enterprise and new verticals

  • Find markets where our product solves urgent, valuable support problems.
  • Build each vertical from research to its first repeatable motion.
  • Define the ICP, triggers, objections, message, proof, channel, and sales play.
  • Help Richpanel win beyond DTC without weakening what already works.

This is a builder's role. You will write, research, ship, and talk to customers yourself.

Requirements

YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF

  • You have 7+ years in B2B SaaS growth, product marketing, brand, or category creation.
  • You have opened a new market, geography, segment, or vertical from zero.
  • You can show work that changed perception and created qualified pipeline.
  • You understand both brand and demand. You do not treat them as separate teams.
  • You write clearly and know how to earn engagement on X.
  • You are comfortable with PPC, AEO, content, events, and partnerships.
  • You have built positioning, launch plans, sales narratives, or competitive battlecards.
  • You enjoy deep research, customer interviews, and field work.
  • You can work directly with a founder and decide with incomplete information.
  • You use AI daily to research, draft, analyze, and move faster.
  • Ecommerce, DTC, CX, or enterprise AI experience is useful, but not mandatory.

THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

  • You only manage agencies or large teams.
  • Your answer to every growth problem is more paid spend.
  • You avoid customer calls, sales calls, or writing.
  • You report impressions without connecting work to buyer behavior or revenue.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 90 days

  • Complete 25 customer, prospect, partner, and lost-deal interviews.
  • Ship a message map, pitch narrative, and four useful battlecards.
  • Build a repeatable X publishing and engagement system.
  • Launch three channel experiments with clear stop or scale rules.
  • Select two new verticals and ship the first GTM test for each.

Six months

  • At least two new channels produce repeatable qualified pipeline.
  • One non-DTC vertical produces a credible opportunity set and clear win-loss evidence.
  • Richpanel's story is consistent across the website, sales deck, demos, and market conversations.

Benefits

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

You are not inheriting a finished playbook. You will decide what Richpanel becomes known for.

You get:

  • Direct access to the CEO, customers, product team, and sales calls.
  • A real budget for research, content, events, and channel experiments.
  • A profitable company with eight-figure ARR, 110% year-over-year growth, and proven customer outcomes.
  • Ownership of the brand, the growth portfolio, and our next markets.
  • A small team with little process between an idea and a live test.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

• $190,000 to $225,000 base salary.

  • 20% target performance bonus. Total target cash compensation is $228,000 to $270,000.
  • 0.5% to 1% equity, vested over four years. This is meaningful ownership, not a token grant.

• 25 paid days off each year.

• Learning and development allowance.

  • Annual offsite and quarterly team gatherings.
  • Remote role based in the United States.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

1. CEO conversation focused on work you personally led.

2. Live working session on one Richpanel vertical and one channel.

3. Evidence review covering writing, research, launches, and business results.

4. Final conversation and references.

We aim to complete the process within two weeks.

raw.description:
Healthcare’s helping hand.

CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

CHG is seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution in a spec-driven development environment. This is an evolution of the traditional Product Manager role — you will not only define the “what and why” of the product roadmap, but you will author detailed technical specifications that give engineering teams the clarity to build with confidence. You will be embedded within engineering workflows, participating in design reviews, reviewing pull requests for spec alignment, and writing prototypes and code to validate your own assumptions. If you are a product leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy and technology, and you believe the best specs come from people who understand both the customer and the code, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Author and own detailed technical specifications for product initiatives, including system context, data flows, API contracts, acceptance criteria, and edge case definitions
  • Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap grounded in customer research, market analysis, and business objectives
  • Write prototypes, proof-of-concept scripts, and lightweight automation to validate assumptions and accelerate decision-making
  • Participate in the building by taking existing code, understand how it works, and deploy changes
  • Partner with engineering as an embedded team member: participate in design reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and pull request reviews for spec alignment
  • Define product metrics, design experiments (A/B tests, cohort analysis), and independently extract and analyze data to drive prioritization
  • Translate technical complexity into clear narratives for business stakeholders and business context into actionable direction for engineers
  • Break large initiatives into shippable increments defined in specs, ensuring a consistent delivery cadence and early detection of scope or quality risks
  • Conduct customer research, competitive analysis, and stakeholder interviews to inform product direction and identify high-leverage opportunities

Qualifications

  • Ability to read, understand, and write code
  • Experience in large scale enterprise projects
  • Strong track record of Delivery & Execution
  • Spec-Driven Product Strategy and Roadmap
  • Stakeholder Communication & Alignment
  • Data Analysis & Insight Generation
  • Outcome Ownership & Value Realization
  • Technical Fluency & Systems Thinking
  • Customer & Market Insight
  • Cross-Functional Engineering Partnership

Education & Experience

  • BS preferred in a relevant field (e.g., computer science, engineering, business, or a related discipline), but relevant professional experience accepted
  • 5+ years of experience in product management with demonstrated technical depth
  • Experience authoring technical specifications, working in codebases, or contributing to engineering workflows.

Preferred

  • Experience with spec-driven or design-doc-driven development processes
  • Code competency — ability to read, understand, and review code
  • Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and pull request workflows
  • Experience with SaaS products, APIs, microservices, or platform products
  • Background in data analysis, A/B testing, and experimentation frameworks
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and delivery management tools (Jira, Confluence)

We believe in fair compensation for all of our people, which is why our pay structure takes into account the cost of labor across U.S. geographic markets. For this position, we offer a pay range of $104,000 -- $201,300 annually, with pay varying depending on work location and job-related factors such as knowledge, position level and experience. During the hiring process, your recruiter can provide more information about the specific salary range for the job location.

CHG Healthcare offers starting salaries for sales positions in the form of total target compensation (TTC = base + commission + bonus), which includes base pay, commission, and bonuses. Sales positions receive short-term incentives through commission plans and bonuses. On the other hand, non-sales positions have starting salaries that consist of a base salary and short-term incentives through various bonus plans, which are paid out monthly, quarterly, or annually.

In return we offer:

• 401(k) retirement plan with company match

• Traditional healthcare benefits such as medical and dental coverage, and some unique benefits like onsite health centers, corporate wellness programs, and free behavioral health appointments.
• Flexible work schedules - including work-from-home options available
• Recognition programs with rewards including trips, cash, and paid time off
• Family-friendly benefits including paid parental leave, fertility coverage, adoption assistance, and marriage counseling
• Tailored training resources including free LinkedIn learning courses
• Volunteer time off and employee-driven matching grants

• Tuition reimbursement programs
